Queen's Recruit#001.src: Tasim is looking to catch up in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Queen's Recruit#002.src: {u}! Hey! It's lucky I managed to catch you here.
Queen's Recruit#002.dst: {u}! Эй! Как удачно, что я тебя застал.
Queen's Recruit#002.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#003.src: It's been a while, hasn't it? We should catch up! You've probably had lots of adventures, right?
Queen's Recruit#003.dst: Сколько лет, а? Надо поболтать! У тебя, наверное, было море приключений?
Queen's Recruit#003.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#004.src: But before that... I've just got to find...
Queen's Recruit#004.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#005.src: Huh? What am I oh, yeah. I'm trying to find Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#005.dst: А? Что я… а, да. Я ищу Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#005.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#006.src: He sent me a letter asking me to join him on some... scouting mission. But I haven't been able to find him.
Queen's Recruit#006.dst: Он прислал письмо, звал на какое-то… разведзадание. Но я никак не могу его найти.
Queen's Recruit#006.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#007.src: It did take me a while to get here... so maybe he's gone somewhere else by now. Aegis did tell me the mission ended up being called off, so...
Queen's Recruit#007.dst: Добирался я долго… может, он уже ушёл куда-то. Aegis сказал, что задание в итоге отменили, так что…
Queen's Recruit#007.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#008.src: But if he's not here, then I should probably stop trying to catch him on the streets, huh? I'll just leave a message for him at the barracks.
Queen's Recruit#008.dst: Но раз его тут нет, хватит ловить его на улицах, да? Оставлю ему записку в казарме.
Queen's Recruit#008.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#009.src: We can head to the tavern and catch up! Gods, I've missed the Rusty Recruit's drinks... that barkeeper, he says it's the same as anywhere else, but it really isn't! Nowhere else pours it like he does.
Queen's Recruit#009.dst: Пойдём в таверну, поболтаем! Боги, как я скучал по выпивке в Rusty Recruit… Бармен говорит, что наливает как все, но нет! Никто так не наливает.
Queen's Recruit#009.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#010.src: Pardon me, excuse me coming through! Coming through! Ah, you two! Just the folks I was looking for.
Queen's Recruit#010.dst: Простите, извините, дорогу! Дорогу! А, вы двое! Вас-то я и искал.
Queen's Recruit#010.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#012.src: Well, perhaps not specifically. I've got a list of folks to try and track down, and the two of you are on it! Tasim and {u}, right?
Queen's Recruit#012.dst: Ну, не именно. У меня список тех, кого надо разыскать, и вы в нём! Tasim и {u}, верно?
Queen's Recruit#012.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#013.src: I've got an important missive from {p}. Direct from the King himself, yep yep!
Queen's Recruit#013.dst: У меня важное послание из {p}. От самого короля, да-да!
Queen's Recruit#013.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#014.src: Really? I don't think I've even seen him since... what could he possibly want us for?
Queen's Recruit#014.dst: Правда? Я его, кажется, с тех пор не видел… зачем мы ему понадобились?
Queen's Recruit#014.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#015.src: I'm not privy to the details I'm afraid! He's summoning a number of you seasoned visitors to the castle, for some sort of meeting.
Queen's Recruit#015.dst: Подробностей, увы, не знаю! Он созывает в замок бывалых гостей вроде вас, на какое-то совещание.
Queen's Recruit#015.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#016.src: Anyway, I've got more to try and track down, so I'll give you the written letters and be on my way! Best of luck with whatever it is!
Queen's Recruit#016.dst: В общем, мне ещё многих искать, так что вот ваши письма, и я побежал! Удачи, что бы там ни было!
Queen's Recruit#016.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#018.src: Hm. That is strange, isn't it? I guess we'll have to call off drinks for later... probably for the best. Maybe I'll be able to catch him before...
Queen's Recruit#018.dst: Хм. Странно, да? Выпивку, видно, придётся отложить… может, оно и к лучшему. Может, успею его застать до…
Queen's Recruit#018.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#019.src: Oh, uh- you go on ahead. I have to stop by the barracks first. I'll meet you in {p}, then?
Queen's Recruit#019.dst: О, э- иди вперёд. Мне сперва надо зайти в казарму. Встретимся в {p}?
Queen's Recruit#019.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#020.src: I'll meet you in {p}. I have to deal with some things at the barracks first.
Queen's Recruit#020.dst: Встретимся в {p}. Сперва мне надо кое-что решить в казарме.
Queen's Recruit#020.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#021.src: Attend the meeting with the King in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Queen's Recruit#021.dst: Приди на совещание с королём в {p} на [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Queen's Recruit#022.src: ...oh, there you are. Didn't you head out before me?
Queen's Recruit#022.dst: …о, вот ты где. Как тебе удалось меня опередить?
Queen's Recruit#022.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#023.src: I don't know most of the people here, so I'll stick with you for now.
Queen's Recruit#023.dst: Я тут почти никого не знаю, так что пока побуду с тобой.
Queen's Recruit#023.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#024.src: ...and it's all crashing down, right? So I knock the zombie back, grab the kid, and jump for
Queen's Recruit#024.dst: …и всё рушится, понимаешь? Я отбрасываю зомби, хватаю ребёнка и прыгаю в
Queen's Recruit#024.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#025.src: Wait, wait wait wait you're tellin' me there was a kid involved? And you still set off the bombs?!
Queen's Recruit#025.dst: Стой, стой-стой-стой, ты хочешь сказать, там был ребёнок? И ты всё равно взорвал бомбы?!
Queen's Recruit#025.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#026.src: Yeah! I said that already, right? That was the whole reason I
Queen's Recruit#026.dst: Ага! Я ж уже говорил, нет? В этом и была вся причина, почему я
Queen's Recruit#026.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#027.src: Ahem. Pause the story for a bit, Linton. We have company.
Queen's Recruit#027.dst: Кхм. Прервись-ка, Linton. У нас гости.
Queen's Recruit#027.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#028.src: Well if it ain't {u}! It's good to see someone else familiar 'round here.
Queen's Recruit#028.dst: Ба, да это ж {u}! Приятно увидеть тут знакомое лицо.
Queen's Recruit#028.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#030.src: I do try to keep my distance.
Queen's Recruit#030.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#031.src: So, you received the summons too? The King has a lot of people here. It's interesting.
Queen's Recruit#031.dst: Значит, вам тоже пришёл вызов? Король собрал много людей. Любопытно.
Queen's Recruit#031.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#032.src: We did, yes. And it sounded like they had even more people on that list that they were searching for.
Queen's Recruit#032.dst: Да, пришёл. И, похоже, в списке ещё много тех, кого они разыскивают.
Queen's Recruit#032.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#033.src: Oh, apologies, I hadn't noticed you there. You're a friend of {u}'s, I take it?
Queen's Recruit#033.dst: О, простите, я вас не заметила. Вы, полагаю, друг {u}?
Queen's Recruit#033.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#034.src: I am! We arrived in Wynn on the same caravan. I'm Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#034.dst: Да! Мы приехали в Wynn в одном караване. Я Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#034.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#036.src: So you're the one Aledar was always talking about! I thought you were off in Gavel?
Queen's Recruit#036.dst: Так это о тебе вечно рассказывал Aledar! Я думал, ты в Gavel?
Queen's Recruit#036.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#037.src: I... was. How do you all know him?
Queen's Recruit#037.dst: Я… был. Откуда вы его знаете?
Queen's Recruit#037.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#038.src: I believe we first met on a mission to reclaim {p}'s barracks from a treasonous commander. We've run into each other a few times since.
Queen's Recruit#038.dst: Кажется, впервые мы встретились, когда отбивали казарму {p} у командира-предателя. С тех пор пересекались не раз.
Queen's Recruit#038.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#039.src: Still, it's good to finally get t' meet you! We've heard lots of stories! Including somethin' about not respondin' to letters...?
Queen's Recruit#039.dst: Ну, рада наконец познакомиться! Столько историй слышали! И что-то там про неотвеченные письма…?
Queen's Recruit#039.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#040.src: Oh... right. We, uh... sorted that out.
Queen's Recruit#040.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#041.src: But speaking of have any of you seen him recently?
Queen's Recruit#041.dst: Кстати, кто-нибудь из вас видел его недавно?
Queen's Recruit#041.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#042.src: 'fraid not. I don't think our paths've crossed since... was it the siege at {p}? Must've been.
Queen's Recruit#042.dst: Боюсь, нет. Кажись, не пересекались с… осады {p}? Точно, с неё.
Queen's Recruit#042.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#043.src: I saw him a month ago in {p}! I asked him what he was working on and if I could help and he just brushed me off. Weird, right?
Queen's Recruit#043.dst: Я видел его месяц назад в {p}! Спросил, чем он занят и можно ли помочь, а он просто отмахнулся. Странно, да?
Queen's Recruit#043.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#044.src: Mmn. No, that sounds like him. I think he had enough of your antics last time.
Queen's Recruit#044.dst: Мм. Нет, это на него похоже. Думаю, в прошлый раз твои выходки его достали.
Queen's Recruit#044.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#045.src: What?! I'm capable. C'mon, Mel, tell her I'm capable.
Queen's Recruit#045.dst: Что?! Я способный. Ну же, Mel, скажи ей, что я способный.
Queen's Recruit#045.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#046.src: Linton, y'were just tellin' us about how you caved in a whole temple by
Queen's Recruit#046.dst: Linton, ты только что рассказывал, как обрушил целый храм, когда
Queen's Recruit#046.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#047.src: Okay! Okay, okay okay, let's talk about literally anything else! Tasim, right? What's... uh...
Queen's Recruit#047.dst: Ладно! Ладно-ладно-ладно, давайте о чём угодно другом! Tasim, да? Что… э…
Queen's Recruit#047.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#048.src: ...so, your... no, no, give me a moment you were... and... um... oh, right...
Queen's Recruit#048.dst: …так, твой… нет-нет, секунду, ты… и… эм… а, точно…
Queen's Recruit#048.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#051.src: Linton!! Y'can't just ask someone that!!
Queen's Recruit#051.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#053.src: It was nice meeting you, Tasim. I look forward to working with you during this mission.
Queen's Recruit#053.dst: Приятно познакомиться, Tasim. Рада буду поработать вместе на этом задании.
Queen's Recruit#053.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#054.src: ...likewise. It's always nice meeting friends of Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#054.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#055.src: Well, look at you! It's been quite a time since we last spoke. Far above the task of cleaning out sewers now, eh?
Queen's Recruit#055.dst: Ну, вы гляньте! Давненько не болтали. Теперь уж не до чистки канализации, а?
Queen's Recruit#055.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#056.src: I've heard some tell of your accomplishments. Fine work, fine work.
Queen's Recruit#056.dst: Слыхал о твоих подвигах. Славная работа, славная.
Queen's Recruit#056.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#057.src: And... hm. Aren't you the one who ran off to Gavel without sayin' a word? Didn't expect you to be one o' the ones picked out for this.
Queen's Recruit#057.dst: И… хм. Не ты ли сбежал в Gavel, не сказав ни слова? Не ждал, что тебя тоже выберут.
Queen's Recruit#057.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#058.src: I... didn't expect it either. I didn't even realize the King still remembered me, truth be told.
Queen's Recruit#058.dst: Я… тоже не ожидал. По правде, я и не думал, что король меня помнит.
Queen's Recruit#058.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#059.src: Mmn. Well, whatever the reason, you're here now. Don't suppose it matters much the path you took to get here. We need all the folks we can get or so Kymer's been sayin'.
Queen's Recruit#059.dst: Мм. Что ж, как бы то ни было, ты здесь. Каким путём пришёл - неважно. Нам нужен каждый - по крайней мере, так говорит Kymer.
Queen's Recruit#059.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#060.src: Well well! If my eyes don't deceive me! {u} and Tasim!
Queen's Recruit#060.dst: Так-так! Если глаза меня не обманывают! {u} и Tasim!
Queen's Recruit#060.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#061.src: I'll say, I didn't quite expect them to track you down! What with your... extended stint off in Gavel.
Queen's Recruit#061.dst: Признаюсь, не ожидал, что вас разыщут! С вашей-то… долгой отлучкой в Gavel.
Queen's Recruit#061.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#062.src: I should say the same about you, captain. Did {p} no longer have a use for you once the war ended?
Queen's Recruit#062.dst: То же могу сказать о вас, капитан. После войны вы стали не нужны {p}?
Queen's Recruit#062.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#063.src: Ah... nothing of the sort. You know, I was sent out there initially to serve as more of an envoy from {p}! If the King needs a diplomatic situation sorted, I'm the one he turns to first.
Queen's Recruit#063.dst: Ах… ничего подобного. Меня изначально туда послали скорее посланником от {p}! Если королю надо уладить дипломатическое дело, он зовёт меня первым.
Queen's Recruit#063.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#064.src: Which... is indeed why I am here now. I was recalled rather abruptly several weeks ago. It seems we've entered a tricky situation with our... neighboring province.
Queen's Recruit#064.dst: Потому… я и здесь. Меня довольно внезапно отозвали несколько недель назад. Похоже, у нас щекотливое положение с нашей… соседней провинцией.
Queen's Recruit#064.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#065.src: But! I shan't say more before the King arrives. He'll tell you all of the problem that hopefully we will be able to resolve.
Queen's Recruit#065.dst: Но! Больше ни слова до прихода короля. Он сам расскажет о проблеме, которую мы, надеюсь, сможем решить.
Queen's Recruit#065.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#066.src: ...I see. We'll leave you to it, then.
Queen's Recruit#066.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#067.src: If we align the manaflow with Water, then nudge it to the side, maybe... ah Reynauld, pass me my notes on... damn, what was it oh, yes, the recovery period! Pass me those ones.
Queen's Recruit#067.dst: Если направить поток маны через Воду, потом сдвинуть вбок, может… а, Reynauld, дай заметки о… чёрт, как же… а, да, период восстановления! Дай их.
Queen's Recruit#067.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#068.src: ...You already have them on your left, doctor.
Queen's Recruit#068.dst: …Они уже лежат слева от вас, доктор.
Queen's Recruit#068.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#069.src: Do I now! It seems I do... oh, but this is only the first half where did I leave the rest...
Queen's Recruit#069.dst: Неужели! И впрямь… о, но это лишь первая половина, куда же я дел остальное…
Queen's Recruit#069.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#070.src: Sigh... If you'd just allow me to organize for you, maybe you wouldn't
Queen's Recruit#070.dst: Эх… Позволили бы мне всё упорядочить, может, не пришлось бы
Queen's Recruit#070.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#071.src: And ruin my predefined sorting system?! No, Reynauld, I do think it works perfectly well as it is, thank you very much! Now, where could it have
Queen's Recruit#071.dst: И разрушить мою продуманную систему сортировки?! Нет, Reynauld, она прекрасно работает, благодарю покорно! Так, где же оно могло
Queen's Recruit#071.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#072.src: Ah! You two! Good, good, you're here I was worried Reynauld would be the only other one with recovered memories around here!
Queen's Recruit#072.dst: А! Вы двое! Хорошо, хорошо, вы здесь, я боялся, что Reynauld тут единственный, к кому вернулась память!
Queen's Recruit#072.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#073.src: What, you didn't test it on anyone else after we left?
Queen's Recruit#073.dst: Что, после нас вы ни на ком больше не проверяли?
Queen's Recruit#073.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#074.src: Test it on no, of course not! After what I saw? No, no, that would certainly not have been worth the risk. No new test subjects until I am certain it's flawless!
Queen's Recruit#074.dst: Проверять на… нет, конечно! После того, что я видел? Нет-нет, это того не стоило. Никаких подопытных, пока не буду уверен в успехе!
Queen's Recruit#074.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#075.src: I've been using it on myself instead! And, let me tell you the breakthroughs I have made... there is much to be learned.
Queen's Recruit#075.dst: Вместо этого я проверял на себе! И скажу вам, какие прорывы я совершил… столько всего можно узнать.
Queen's Recruit#075.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#077.src: Pah! "Safety" a meaningless term made only to stifle progress. Have there been side effects certainly! But it has all been worth it.
Queen's Recruit#077.dst: Пф! «Безопасность» - пустое слово, чтобы душить прогресс. Побочные эффекты? Разумеется! Но оно того стоило.
Queen's Recruit#077.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#078.src: Now, I must return to the pages... I've some equations I need to perfect before the King arrives...
Queen's Recruit#078.dst: Так, мне пора к записям… надо довести до ума пару уравнений до прихода короля…
Queen's Recruit#078.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#079.src: Hm. I can't say I would have expected you to be here, Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#079.dst: Хм. Не ожидал увидеть тебя здесь, Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#079.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#080.src: Well... fate has other plans, I guess. How about you? Did you stay in {p}?
Queen's Recruit#080.dst: Ну… у судьбы свои планы, видимо. А ты? Остался в {p}?
Queen's Recruit#080.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#081.src: Mostly. Moved around for a few assignments here and there, but I kept coming back.
Queen's Recruit#081.dst: В основном. Переезжал ради пары заданий, но всегда возвращался.
Queen's Recruit#081.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#082.src: ...we haven't spoken in a while. Are you... doing well? How have you been managing the memories?
Queen's Recruit#082.dst: …мы давно не говорили. Ты… в порядке? Как справляешься с воспоминаниями?
Queen's Recruit#082.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#084.src: As well as I could be expected to, I guess. It was rough for the first few months. Eventually, I got used to it.
Queen's Recruit#084.dst: Насколько можно ожидать, наверное. Первые месяцы было тяжко. Потом привык.
Queen's Recruit#084.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#085.src: How about you? I also wouldn't have expected you to show for a mission like this.
Queen's Recruit#085.dst: А ты? Я тоже не ожидал, что ты явишься на такое задание.
Queen's Recruit#085.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#086.src: Same as you. Helped that Caid and I managed to talk it through. We meet every so often, talk about it. He talks about his sister, how he wants to find her one day.
Queen's Recruit#086.dst: Как и ты. Помогло, что мы с Caid всё обсудили. Иногда встречаемся, говорим об этом. Он рассказывает о сестре, как хочет однажды её найти.
Queen's Recruit#086.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#088.src: Hm. Nothing stopping you from stopping by, yourself. It might even help you.
Queen's Recruit#088.dst: Хм. Ничто не мешает и тебе заглянуть. Может, даже поможет.
Queen's Recruit#088.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#089.src: I'll... consider it. Good to see you again, Reynauld.
Queen's Recruit#089.dst: Я… подумаю. Рад снова тебя видеть, Reynauld.
Queen's Recruit#089.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#090.src: Another soldier? Allow me to see your summons.
Queen's Recruit#090.dst: Ещё один солдат? Покажите ваш вызов.
Queen's Recruit#090.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#091.src: ...good. Come on in, {u}. The King will be arriving shortly.
Queen's Recruit#091.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#093.src: If you insist. Don't take too long.
Queen's Recruit#093.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#094.src: Ah... here we are. I thank you all for coming on such short notice. It has been some time since I have seen many of you.
Queen's Recruit#094.dst: А… вот и все. Благодарю, что пришли по столь срочному зову. Многих из вас я давно не видел.
Queen's Recruit#094.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#095.src: ...I'll get right to the point. We find ourselves in a very delicate position when it comes to relations with our neighboring province, Fruma.
Queen's Recruit#095.dst: …Перейду к делу. Мы в очень деликатном положении в отношениях с соседней провинцией, Fruma.
Queen's Recruit#095.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#096.src: We rely heavily on the flow of new recruits sent to us, but we have no means of contacting their province. Only they may reach out to us, and only once they have chosen to do so.
Queen's Recruit#096.dst: Мы сильно зависим от присылаемых новобранцев, но связаться с их провинцией не можем. Лишь они могут выйти на нас, и лишь когда сами решат.
Queen's Recruit#096.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#097.src: ...several weeks ago, we received a cloaked visitor through the outskirts. She claimed to be of Fruma, one of their Sovereigns.
Queen's Recruit#097.dst: …несколько недель назад к нам через окраины пришла гостья в плаще. Назвалась уроженкой Fruma, одной из их Суверенов.
Queen's Recruit#097.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#098.src: We were extended an invitation, of sorts. Of all the recruits we have ever received, we were to select the greatest, and send them into Fruma for some sort of celebration.
Queen's Recruit#098.dst: Нам передали своего рода приглашение. Из всех новобранцев, что к нам поступали, мы должны выбрать лучших и отправить в Fruma на некое торжество.
Queen's Recruit#098.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#099.src: Is that who we are? The greatest?
Queen's Recruit#099.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#100.src: The ones that could be reached, at the very least! Perhaps some were greater yet, but we all know the roaming habits of your sort, and tracking them down really can prove
Queen's Recruit#100.dst: По крайней мере, те, кого удалось найти! Может, были и лучше, но все мы знаем, как ваш брат любит бродяжничать, и разыскать их бывает
Queen's Recruit#100.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#101.src: Ugh, we're not going along with this, are we?
Queen's Recruit#101.dst: Фу, мы же не станем на это соглашаться?
Queen's Recruit#101.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#103.src: What? They're demanding something weird and obviously suspicious, so why should we just accept it?
Queen's Recruit#103.dst: Что? Они требуют что-то странное и явно подозрительное, так с чего нам соглашаться?
Queen's Recruit#103.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#104.src: I'm afraid we don't have a choice in the matter. As I mentioned, the recruits we receive make all the difference in our province's continued survival. If we were to reject this invitation...
Queen's Recruit#104.dst: Боюсь, выбора у нас нет. Как я сказал, новобранцы решают всё для выживания нашей провинции. Если мы отвергнем приглашение…
Queen's Recruit#104.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#105.src: ...who's to say they wouldn't just stop sendin' 'em, eh? Tough.
Queen's Recruit#105.dst: …кто скажет, что они не перестанут их слать, а? Дело дрянь.
Queen's Recruit#105.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#106.src: Besides all that, think of the opportunity this presents! A true, freely-given view of what lies beyond those walls! We'd be fools not to accept it, no matter the implied threat!
Queen's Recruit#106.dst: К тому же подумайте, какая возможность! Настоящий, добровольно открытый взгляд на то, что за стенами! Глупо отказываться, какой бы ни была угроза!
Queen's Recruit#106.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#107.src: Indeed. I regret that I must request this of you... but there is no other choice. You must accept this invitation.
Queen's Recruit#107.dst: Именно. Сожалею, что вынужден просить вас об этом… но выбора нет. Вы должны принять приглашение.
Queen's Recruit#107.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#108.src: ...even those of us with bad experiences of the province?
Queen's Recruit#108.dst: …даже те из нас, у кого с той провинцией плохие воспоминания?
Queen's Recruit#108.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#109.src: I apologize... but you must. My hands are tied.
Queen's Recruit#109.dst: Прошу прощения… но да. У меня связаны руки.
Queen's Recruit#109.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#110.src: I take it we are expected to gather as much intelligence on Fruma as we can while we're in there?
Queen's Recruit#110.dst: Полагаю, от нас ждут, что там мы соберём как можно больше сведений о Fruma?
Queen's Recruit#110.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#111.src: That's the plan, indeed! I'll explain more once we're there, but I believe we're on a time limit, correct?
Queen's Recruit#111.dst: Таков план! Подробнее объясню на месте, но у нас ведь ограничено время, верно?
Queen's Recruit#111.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#112.src: You are correct, doctor. I have been told that a representative will greet you all at the royal gates of Fruma, situated on the western coast.
Queen's Recruit#112.dst: Верно, доктор. Мне сообщили, что представитель встретит вас у королевских ворот Fruma на западном побережье.
Queen's Recruit#112.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#113.src: I've sent a courier ahead to {p} to inform the local captains of the destination they are to take you to.
Queen's Recruit#113.dst: Я уже отправил гонца в {p}, чтобы местные капитаны знали, куда вас везти.
Queen's Recruit#113.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#114.src: {p}... I know a captain there. {u}, want to join me?
Queen's Recruit#114.dst: {p}… Я знаю там одного капитана. {u}, пойдёшь со мной?
Queen's Recruit#114.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#115.src: Finally... a glimpse at the province's inner workings... how long have I been seeking these answers?
Queen's Recruit#115.dst: Наконец… взглянуть, как устроена провинция изнутри… сколько лет я искал эти ответы?
Queen's Recruit#115.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#116.src: So many theories... how many will be proven right? How many will be wrong? I cannot wait to find out!
Queen's Recruit#116.dst: Столько теорий… сколько подтвердится? Сколько окажутся ошибкой? Жду не дождусь!
Queen's Recruit#116.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#117.src: Sigh... I did know this was coming. Why else would the doctor have been summoned? But I hoped I was wrong.
Queen's Recruit#117.dst: Эх… я знал, что так будет. Зачем ещё звать доктора? Но надеялся, что ошибаюсь.
Queen's Recruit#117.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#118.src: Tough situation, isn't it? Lots o' secrecy on part of the Frumans...
Queen's Recruit#118.dst: Непростое положение, а? Больно много тайн у жителей Fruma…
Queen's Recruit#118.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#119.src: But we'll handle it. Everyone here's plenty capable, after all.
Queen's Recruit#119.dst: Но справимся. Тут все ребята толковые, в конце концов.
Queen's Recruit#119.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#120.src: Hm... what a situation it is we find ourselves in! Diplomacy is my specialty, of course, but my expertise has not prepared me for... this.
Queen's Recruit#120.dst: Хм… ну и положение у нас! Дипломатия, конечно, мой конёк, но опыт не подготовил меня к… такому.
Queen's Recruit#120.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#121.src: Fruma knows what they want, and know they are strong enough that they can afford to let up their position.
Queen's Recruit#121.dst: Fruma знает, чего хочет, и знает, что достаточно сильна, чтобы в любой момент отступиться.
Queen's Recruit#121.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#122.src: Another top secret mission already? And I'm not even allowed to bring my explosives?
Queen's Recruit#122.dst: Опять сверхсекретное задание? И мне даже взрывчатку нельзя взять?
Queen's Recruit#122.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#123.src: It's interesting, at least! Way better than that last assignment...
Queen's Recruit#123.dst: Зато интересно! Куда лучше, чем прошлое поручение…
Queen's Recruit#123.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#124.src: This mission's a big deal, huh? Lot's o' strong folks recalled for it, at least.
Queen's Recruit#124.dst: Задание-то серьёзное, а? Столько сильных ребят отозвали.
Queen's Recruit#124.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#125.src: Makes me a bit nervous, honestly!
Queen's Recruit#125.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#126.src: Fruma... I can't say it's been on my mind much. It's a mystery, yes, but not one with any available answers.
Queen's Recruit#126.dst: Fruma… не скажу, что часто о ней думала. Загадка, да, но без доступных ответов.
Queen's Recruit#126.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#127.src: Well, until now, I suppose. I'll have to prepare a list of details to look out for...
Queen's Recruit#127.dst: Что ж, до сих пор, видимо. Надо составить список деталей, на которые смотреть…
Queen's Recruit#127.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#128.src: And yet again, I must send you all into danger... a different sort, this time around, but danger nonetheless.
Queen's Recruit#128.dst: И вновь я вынужден послать вас на опасность… иного рода на этот раз, но опасность всё же.
Queen's Recruit#128.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#129.src: I remember each face which passes through my castle. I rarely see any of them again.
Queen's Recruit#129.dst: Я помню каждое лицо, что проходит через мой замок. Редко кого вижу снова.
Queen's Recruit#129.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#130.src: But this time... I have faith we will meet once more. Go on, young hero. Your mission lies ahead of you.
Queen's Recruit#130.dst: Но в этот раз… верю, что мы встретимся. Ступай, юный герой. Твоё задание впереди.
Queen's Recruit#130.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#131.src: ...back to Fruma. I've only just come back to Wynn, and now...
Queen's Recruit#131.dst: …обратно в Fruma. Я только вернулся в Wynn, а теперь…
Queen's Recruit#131.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#132.src: But it had to happen eventually. And I do want answers. So... in we go.
Queen's Recruit#132.dst: Но рано или поздно это случилось бы. И я хочу ответов. Так что… вперёд.
Queen's Recruit#132.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#133.src: I'll be heading to the {p} Seaskipper, if you want to tag along.
Queen's Recruit#133.dst: Я пойду к парому в {p}, если хочешь со мной.
Queen's Recruit#133.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#134.src: Travel to the Gate of Fruma at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] or meet up with Tasim in {p}.
Queen's Recruit#134.dst: Доберись до ворот Fruma на [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] или встреться с Tasim в {p}.

Queen's Recruit#135.src: ...Oh! You're here! Lost in thought, sorry.
Queen's Recruit#135.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#136.src: It's all a little surreal, isn't it? I only just got back to Wynn, and now... Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#136.dst: Всё как-то нереально, да? Я только вернулся в Wynn, а теперь… Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#136.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#137.src: Kind of make me wish we had Aledar here too. The three of us on an adventure again! Going back... home...
Queen's Recruit#137.dst: Жаль, Aledar нет с нами. Мы втроём снова в приключении! Возвращаемся… домой…
Queen's Recruit#137.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#138.src: I guess we'll just have to tell him all about it when we get back. He'll be sad he missed it, I bet.
Queen's Recruit#138.dst: Придётся рассказать ему всё, когда вернёмся. Спорим, он расстроится, что пропустил.
Queen's Recruit#138.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#139.src: Oi, there! Are those my two favorite customers I see?
Queen's Recruit#139.dst: Эй, там! Неужто мои два любимых клиента?
Queen's Recruit#139.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#140.src: You call everyone your favorite customer, captain! Don't think I didn't notice!
Queen's Recruit#140.dst: Вы всех зовёте любимыми клиентами, капитан! Думаете, я не заметил?
Queen's Recruit#140.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#141.src: Eheheheh, well, it's true, ain't it? I got lots o' favorites! Ah, anyhow, you're here for a trip, ain't'cha?
Queen's Recruit#141.dst: Хе-хе-хе, так ведь правда, а? Любимых у меня много! Ну да ладно, вы ж поплыть пришли, а?
Queen's Recruit#141.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#142.src: We are! You've... probably heard the details already? There should have been something about a new destination.
Queen's Recruit#142.dst: Да! Вы… наверное, уже в курсе? Вам должны были сообщить о новом пункте назначения.
Queen's Recruit#142.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#143.src: Aye. That I have. Some scrawny {p} courier wooshed past earlier! I barely got a word in before he was off again! Real interesting fellow.
Queen's Recruit#143.dst: Ага. В курсе. Какой-то тощий гонец из {p} промчался тут! Я и слова вставить не успел, а он уже умчал! Занятный малый.
Queen's Recruit#143.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#144.src: ... Not a part o' the sea I like to visit, but I reckon I can make an exception this time.
Queen's Recruit#144.dst: …Не люблю я те воды, но на этот раз, пожалуй, сделаю исключение.
Queen's Recruit#144.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#145.src: Hm... I can pay you extra for the trip, if you'd like.
Queen's Recruit#145.dst: Хм… могу доплатить за поездку, если хотите.
Queen's Recruit#145.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#146.src: Ha! No, no, there's no need for that. It's free of charge for my two favorite customers, eheh!
Queen's Recruit#146.dst: Ха! Нет-нет, не надо. Для двух любимых клиентов бесплатно, хе-хе!
Queen's Recruit#146.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#147.src: ...and, 'course, s'all paid for from {p}'s royal coffers anyhow. Now, hop on abour 'fore I change my mind and leave without ya!
Queen's Recruit#147.dst: …да и платит всё равно казна {p}. Ну, живо на борт, пока я не передумал и не уплыл без вас!
Queen's Recruit#147.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#149.src: ...Oh! You're here! Lost in thought, sorry.
Queen's Recruit#149.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#150.src: It's all a little surreal, isn't it? I only just got back to Wynn, and now... Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#150.dst: Всё как-то нереально, да? Я только вернулся в Wynn, а теперь… Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#150.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#151.dst: Жаль, Aledar нет с нами. Мы втроём снова в приключении! Возвращаемся… домой…
Queen's Recruit#151.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#152.dst: Придётся рассказать ему всё, когда вернёмся. Спорим, он расстроится, что пропустил.
Queen's Recruit#152.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#161.dst: …да и платит всё равно казна {p}. Ну, живо на борт, пока я не передумал и не уплыл без вас!
Queen's Recruit#161.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#163.src: ...so, Fruma, eh? I'd ask what business ya've got there, but... figure it's top secret.
Queen's Recruit#163.dst: …значит, Fruma, а? Спросил бы, что за дела у вас там, но… небось сверхсекретно.
Queen's Recruit#163.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#164.src: We've been... invited into the province. Supposedly, it's for some sort of celebration, but...
Queen's Recruit#164.dst: Нас… пригласили в провинцию. Якобы на какое-то торжество, но…
Queen's Recruit#164.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#165.src: Mmn. Aye, knowin' the rumors... not the kind o' place to just invite folks in, is it?
Queen's Recruit#165.dst: Мм. Ага, зная слухи… не то это место, куда просто так зовут, а?
Queen's Recruit#165.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#168.src: Tell me, what's on yer mind then? The both o' you. Speakin' thoughts out tends to make 'em easier to manage, in my experience.
Queen's Recruit#168.dst: Скажите-ка, что у вас на уме? У обоих. По моему опыту, высказанные мысли легче укротить.
Queen's Recruit#168.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#169.src: Fruma went through all that trouble to erase our memories, to get rid of us... just to ask for us back out of nowhere.
Queen's Recruit#169.dst: Fruma столько сил потратила, чтобы стереть нам память, избавиться от нас… и вдруг зовёт обратно.
Queen's Recruit#169.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#170.src: I don't know why they're doing it, but I'm worried there's more going on.
Queen's Recruit#170.dst: Не знаю, зачем им это, но боюсь, тут кроется что-то ещё.
Queen's Recruit#170.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#171.src: I've not got more of a clue than either o' you, but I reckon that suspicion is warranted.
Queen's Recruit#171.dst: Знаю я не больше вашего, но, по-моему, подозрения оправданы.
Queen's Recruit#171.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#172.src: But don't let it consume you, aye? Some suspicion is healthy, but if it colors everything ya do, it'll hurt ya just as bad as naivety would. Keep an open mind.
Queen's Recruit#172.dst: Только не дай им тебя поглотить, а? Немного подозрительности полезно, но если она окрашивает всё, вредит не хуже наивности. Не закрывайся.
Queen's Recruit#172.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#173.src: ...it's possible. I hope you're right, and it is all fine, and we are all overthinking it...
Queen's Recruit#173.dst: …возможно. Надеюсь, вы правы, всё в порядке, и мы просто накручиваем себя…
Queen's Recruit#173.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#174.src: But I can't let my guard down. Everything about this situation is screaming that something isn't right, and... I don't know what.
Queen's Recruit#174.dst: Но терять бдительность нельзя. Всё здесь кричит, что что-то не так, и… я не знаю, что.
Queen's Recruit#174.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#175.src: Nothin' wrong with hopin' for the best. Stayin' positive is all ya can really do, sometimes.
Queen's Recruit#175.dst: Нет ничего плохого в надежде на лучшее. Порой только и остаётся, что не унывать.
Queen's Recruit#175.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#176.src: Out here on the sea, we have a saying... go searchin' for the storm, and it'll find ya itself. Don't expect the worst, or it'll find a way to come to pass.
Queen's Recruit#176.dst: У нас на море есть присказка… ищешь бурю - она сама тебя найдёт. Не жди худшего, а то оно найдёт способ сбыться.
Queen's Recruit#176.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#177.src: ...home? Home. I guess. It'll be nice to have more memories of it than just... you know. Curses, and all that.
Queen's Recruit#177.dst: …домой? Домой. Наверное. Хорошо бы помнить о нём не только… ну, понимаешь. Проклятия и всё такое.
Queen's Recruit#177.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#178.src: Hm. I don’t got much of a home to get back to, either. Had it taken from me by those I trusted, eheh!
Queen's Recruit#178.dst: Хм. Мне тоже особо некуда возвращаться. Дом у меня отняли те, кому я доверял, хе-хе!
Queen's Recruit#178.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#179.src: ... But, I made my own home, out here on the sea. Think even if I could go back now, I wouldn’t!
Queen's Recruit#179.dst: …Но я построил себе дом здесь, на море. Думаю, даже если б мог вернуться - не стал бы!
Queen's Recruit#179.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#180.src: So, if y’don’t like what ya find... don’t feel forced to take it, y’hear?
Queen's Recruit#180.dst: Не понравится то, что найдёшь… не думай, что надо мириться, слыхал?
Queen's Recruit#180.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#181.src: ...I'll keep that in mind. Thank you, captain.
Queen's Recruit#181.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#182.src: Ah, it's what I'm here for, ain't it? Givin' sage advice and salin' folks around the sea!
Queen's Recruit#182.dst: Ах, я ж для того и тут, а? Мудрые советы давать да людей по морю возить!
Queen's Recruit#182.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#183.src: And look at that, on the horizon! Shinin' opulent docks... seems we've arrived.
Queen's Recruit#183.dst: А глядите-ка, на горизонте! Роскошные сияющие причалы… кажись, прибыли.
Queen's Recruit#183.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#184.src: Dunno what you'll be facin' in there... but good luck anyway, aye?
Queen's Recruit#184.dst: Не знаю, что вас там ждёт… но удачи всё равно, а?
Queen's Recruit#184.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#185.src: We'll need it. Thanks for bringing us here, captain.
Queen's Recruit#185.dst: Она нам понадобится. Спасибо, что довезли, капитан.
Queen's Recruit#185.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#187.src: It's... impressive. To build something like this for a gate no one ever uses...
Queen's Recruit#187.dst: Это… впечатляет. Построить такое ради ворот, которыми никто не пользуется…
Queen's Recruit#187.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#188.src: I guess they have the resources to spare.
Queen's Recruit#188.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#189.src: Meet up with the group at the gate at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Queen's Recruit#189.dst: Встреться с отрядом у ворот на [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Queen's Recruit#190.src: Finally! The stragglers arrive. You certainly took your time, didn't you?
Queen's Recruit#190.dst: Наконец! Отстающие прибыли. Вы явно не спешили, а?
Queen's Recruit#190.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#192.src: Not the time, Kymer. Leave the poor man be for an hour, eh? Got bigger fish to fry, n' all that.
Queen's Recruit#192.dst: Не время, Kymer. Дай бедняге хоть час покоя, а? У нас дела поважнее и всё такое.
Queen's Recruit#192.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#193.src: Yes, yes, fine. We've not been able to get a word out of any of these soldiers! Do we even have the right time and place?
Queen's Recruit#193.dst: Да-да, ладно. Мы ни слова не смогли вытянуть из этих солдат! Мы хоть с временем и местом не ошиблись?
Queen's Recruit#193.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#194.src: Nah, you just haven't been trying hard enough. Hey, tin can! This is Fruma, right?
Queen's Recruit#194.dst: Не, ты просто плохо старался. Эй, консервная банка! Это ведь Fruma?
Queen's Recruit#194.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#198.src: It really is an impressive construction, isn't it? All this for a closed-off province.
Queen's Recruit#198.dst: Впечатляющее сооружение, правда? И всё это ради закрытой провинции.
Queen's Recruit#198.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#199.src: Impressive or not, we have work to do! On your guard, everyone. We don't know what to expect, so watch your backs.
Queen's Recruit#199.dst: Впечатляет или нет, у нас работа! Всем быть начеку. Мы не знаем, чего ждать, так что берегите спины.
Queen's Recruit#199.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#200.src: S'anyone's guess when they'll actually let us in...
Queen's Recruit#200.dst: Кто ж знает, когда нас на самом деле впустят…
Queen's Recruit#200.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#203.src: Soldiers of Wynn! Her Majesty welcomes you to the province, as guests of the crown!
Queen's Recruit#203.dst: Солдаты Wynn! Её Величество приветствует вас в провинции как гостей короны!
Queen's Recruit#203.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#204.src: Follow me, and you will be escorted to the royal palace. Let's not keep her waiting you all are of great importance to her.
Queen's Recruit#204.dst: Следуйте за мной, вас сопроводят в королевский дворец. Не заставим её ждать - вы для неё очень важны.
Queen's Recruit#204.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#205.src: Listen to the introduction. Go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to return to the palace.
Queen's Recruit#205.dst: Выслушай приветствие. Пройди к [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], чтобы вернуться во дворец.

Queen's Recruit#206.src: Fruma's... a lot bigger than what I saw in my memories...
Queen's Recruit#206.dst: Fruma… куда больше, чем я видел в воспоминаниях…
Queen's Recruit#206.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#207.src: I guess that makes sense. I probably didn't travel much, back then. But... still.
Queen's Recruit#207.dst: Логично, наверное. Тогда я вряд ли много путешествовал. Но… всё же.
Queen's Recruit#207.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#209.src: It... was. I don't know what I expected going in, but... it was stunning.
Queen's Recruit#209.dst: Это… да. Не знаю, чего я ждал, но… это потрясающе.
Queen's Recruit#209.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#210.src: Ha! Yeah, you know, I think you're right. It was impressive, but Gavel also has impressive sights.
Queen's Recruit#210.dst: Ха! Да, знаешь, пожалуй, так и есть. Впечатляет, но и в Gavel виды не хуже.
Queen's Recruit#210.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#211.src: But let's not get distracted. The tour felt very... controlled. We were never let out of the carriages, and the Sovereign was keeping a watchful eye on us.
Queen's Recruit#211.dst: Но не будем отвлекаться. Экскурсия была очень… подконтрольной. Нас не выпускали из карет, а Суверен не сводил с нас глаз.
Queen's Recruit#211.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#212.src: I'm interested in what they're choosing not to show us...
Queen's Recruit#212.dst: Мне интересно, что именно они решили нам не показывать…
Queen's Recruit#212.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#215.src: It is my honor as Queen to facilitate your return to our wonderful province. Though long you have spent away, you will always remain children of Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#215.dst: Для меня, Королевы, честь вернуть вас в нашу чудесную провинцию. Как бы долго вас ни было, вы навеки дети Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#215.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#216.src: Your work to battle against the blight beyond our walls has been of great interest. You have certainly made our province proud.
Queen's Recruit#216.dst: Ваша борьба с напастью за нашими стенами вызвала большой интерес. Провинция вами по праву гордится.
Queen's Recruit#216.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#217.src: You must have questions on the nature of your summons. All will be revealed but first, allow me to introduce two of my wonderful Sovereigns.
Queen's Recruit#217.dst: У вас наверняка есть вопросы о причинах вызова. Всё откроется, но сперва позвольте представить двух моих чудесных Суверенов.
Queen's Recruit#217.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#218.src: You heard my name, but let me introduce myself. I am
Queen's Recruit#218.dst: Моё имя вы слышали, но позвольте представиться. Я
Queen's Recruit#218.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#219.src: Majin of House Thalas, the Morning Star, Sovereign of our fair {p}. It's a pleasure, dear soldiers, to join our Queen for this ceremony!
Queen's Recruit#219.dst: Majin из дома Thalas, Утренняя Звезда, Суверен нашего прекрасного {p}. Рад, дорогие солдаты, разделить с Королевой эту церемонию!
Queen's Recruit#219.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#221.src: ...Zhiraok Nasin, Sovereign of the {p}. The value of that title should speak for itself.
Queen's Recruit#221.dst: …Zhiraok Nasin, Суверен {p}. Ценность этого титула говорит сама за себя.
Queen's Recruit#221.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#222.src: Thank you, Sovereigns. These two, and the rest, are my council for ruling over our province. Each Sovereign is given governance over their own district, and works to serve the people there.
Queen's Recruit#222.dst: Благодарю, Суверены. Эти двое и остальные - мой совет по управлению провинцией. Каждому Суверену вверен свой округ, и он служит его жителям.
Queen's Recruit#222.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#223.src: There are others. Though none could attend this event they find themselves occupied with various assignments.
Queen's Recruit#223.dst: Есть и другие. Но никто не смог прийти - все заняты разными поручениями.
Queen's Recruit#223.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#224.src: Enough of the boring talk! It is time for the welcoming feast!
Queen's Recruit#224.dst: Довольно скучных речей! Время приветственного пира!
Queen's Recruit#224.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#225.src: We would like to share a taste of what our province has to deliver. Please find your way to the grand dining hall, situated just behind me.
Queen's Recruit#225.dst: Мы хотим дать вам вкусить то, чем богата наша провинция. Пройдите, пожалуйста, в большой обеденный зал прямо за мной.
Queen's Recruit#225.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#226.src: Head to the royal dining hall at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#226.dst: Пройди в королевский обеденный зал на [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#227.src: Make your way to the dining hall, the Queen will be starting her speech soon.
Queen's Recruit#227.dst: Проходите в обеденный зал, Королева скоро начнёт речь.
Queen's Recruit#227.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#228.src: ...you can't even follow the order of operations while Her Majesty is watching?! What kind of expected value must the recruits ha
Queen's Recruit#228.dst: …ты даже порядок действий соблюсти не можешь при Её Величестве?! Какое же матожидание должно быть у новобранцев, ес
Queen's Recruit#228.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#229.src: Now, now, Nasin, settle down. We wouldn't want to leave a poor impression on our guest, would we?
Queen's Recruit#229.dst: Ну-ну, Nasin, успокойся. Мы же не хотим произвести дурное впечатление на гостя, верно?
Queen's Recruit#229.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#231.src: Oh, you. You should report to the dining hall with the remainder of your group.
Queen's Recruit#231.dst: О, ты. Тебе следует пройти в обеденный зал к остальной группе.
Queen's Recruit#231.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#232.src: Yes, yes, move along. You certainly don't want to keep Her Majesty waiting!
Queen's Recruit#232.dst: Да-да, проходи. Не хочешь же ты заставлять Её Величество ждать!
Queen's Recruit#232.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#233.src: Well, I have put it off long enough. Before the first course is served, I will reveal the purpose of your presence here today.
Queen's Recruit#233.dst: Что ж, я достаточно тянула. Прежде чем подадут первое блюдо, я раскрою цель вашего присутствия здесь.
Queen's Recruit#233.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#234.src: In celebration of your work in the Wynn Province, we shall be hosting a tournament! You will all partake in a set of duels in order to crown the greatest soldier among you.
Queen's Recruit#234.dst: В честь ваших трудов в провинции Wynn мы проведём турнир! Вы все сразитесь в череде дуэлей, чтобы увенчать величайшего воина среди вас.
Queen's Recruit#234.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#235.src: You have all grown in your time spent beyond our walls, and what better way to show it?
Queen's Recruit#235.dst: Вы все выросли за нашими стенами, и как лучше это показать?
Queen's Recruit#235.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#236.src: We will, of course, provide compensation for all participants. A generous monetary reward shall be granted to each of you, no matter your placing in the tournament.
Queen's Recruit#236.dst: Разумеется, все участники получат вознаграждение. Щедрая денежная награда ждёт каждого, какое бы место он ни занял.
Queen's Recruit#236.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#237.src: However, for whichever of you finds themselves crowned winner... a greater reward awaits. The specifics shall be revealed once the tournament has concluded.
Queen's Recruit#237.dst: Однако того, кто станет победителем… ждёт награда куда больше. Подробности откроются по завершении турнира.
Queen's Recruit#237.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#238.src: Ah, your majesty if I may... I am not much of a fighter my specialty is in research and study of magic.
Queen's Recruit#238.dst: Ах, Ваше Величество, если позволите… я не боец, моя специальность - исследование и изучение магии.
Queen's Recruit#238.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#239.src: ...very well. Accommodations shall be made. A different request may be made of you later, in exchange.
Queen's Recruit#239.dst: …хорошо. Для вас сделают исключение. Взамен позже вас могут попросить о другом.
Queen's Recruit#239.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#240.src: I thank you for your grace and understanding, your majesty.
Queen's Recruit#240.dst: Благодарю за милость и понимание, Ваше Величество.
Queen's Recruit#240.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#241.src: Yes... now. Once the meal comes to a close, you shall all be assigned a room to stay in for the remainder of your stay in my palace.
Queen's Recruit#241.dst: Да… итак. После трапезы каждому выделят комнату на всё время пребывания в моём дворце.
Queen's Recruit#241.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#242.src: Ah! It seems the first course has been prepared! Please, enjoy our province's finest cuisine.
Queen's Recruit#242.dst: А! Кажется, первое блюдо готово! Прошу, наслаждайтесь лучшей кухней нашей провинции.
Queen's Recruit#242.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#243.src: ...I can't say I was expecting that, of all things.
Queen's Recruit#243.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#244.src: You'll be joining the tournament, right?
Queen's Recruit#244.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#246.src: We'd better get going and find our rooms everyone else headed south.
Queen's Recruit#246.dst: Пора найти наши комнаты, все пошли на юг.
Queen's Recruit#246.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#247.src: Get your assigned room from the representative at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#249.src: Your rooms are located on the east and west side of here.
Queen's Recruit#249.dst: Ваши комнаты находятся к востоку и западу отсюда.
Queen's Recruit#249.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#250.src: Your rooms are on the other side of the castle. Please make your way over there.
Queen's Recruit#250.dst: Ваши комнаты на другой стороне замка. Пройдите, пожалуйста, туда.
Queen's Recruit#250.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#255.src: Talk about a fancy feast, huh?
Queen's Recruit#255.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#256.src: They're really pullin' out all the stops, huh? Don't think I've had anythin' that good in a long while.
Queen's Recruit#256.dst: Они и впрямь расстарались, а? Давненько я не ела ничего такого вкусного.
Queen's Recruit#256.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#257.src: Yeah, that was probably the best meal I've had in a long time... Really tired me out. Can't wait for a long and good rest.
Queen's Recruit#257.dst: Да, это, пожалуй, лучший обед за долгое время… Даже утомился. Жду не дождусь хорошего отдыха.
Queen's Recruit#257.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#258.src: Ah, there we are. Tasim and {u}, you'll be in room W3... in the western wing.
Queen's Recruit#258.dst: А, вот. Tasim и {u}, вы в комнате W3… в западном крыле.
Queen's Recruit#258.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#259.src: How 'bout us? I'm Mel, and this is Linton.
Queen's Recruit#259.dst: А мы? Я Mel, а это Linton.
Queen's Recruit#259.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#262.src: Mel and Lanu, you'll be in E2.
Queen's Recruit#262.dst: Mel и Lanu, вы в E2.
Queen's Recruit#262.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#263.src: Uh hey, I think you forgot someone! Where am I staying?
Queen's Recruit#263.dst: Э, эй, по-моему, вы кого-то забыли! Где живу я?
Queen's Recruit#263.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#266.src: Linton and Kymer are in W2.
Queen's Recruit#266.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#267.src: Oh... uh, Kymer, huh? That's... hm. Okay.
Queen's Recruit#267.dst: О… э, с Kymer, значит? Это… хм. Ладно.
Queen's Recruit#267.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#269.src: Head to your room, W-{~}, and check it out.
Queen's Recruit#269.dst: Пройди в свою комнату W-{~} и осмотрись.

Queen's Recruit#270.src: Room W3... Now get going. I have a lot of rooms to assign...
Queen's Recruit#270.dst: Комната W3… Ступайте. Мне ещё много комнат распределять…
Queen's Recruit#270.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#271.src: I'm just gonna wait here for Lanu.
Queen's Recruit#271.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#272.src: Hm... {u}? Think you've got the wrong room!
Queen's Recruit#272.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#273.src: Odd that I've got a room all to myself... but eh, I won't complain.
Queen's Recruit#273.dst: Странно, что у меня комната на одного… но, эх, жаловаться не стану.
Queen's Recruit#273.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#274.src: Kymer. Sure! Cool, cool cool cool... I can stay with the... big biceps... yep. That's... fine. That's fine. Good, even.
Queen's Recruit#274.dst: Kymer. Конечно! Круто, круто-круто… Жить с… большими бицепсами… ага. Это… нормально. Нормально. Даже хорошо.
Queen's Recruit#274.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#276.src: It seems cozy enough, I guess... hard to relax, though, given... you know. all of it.
Queen's Recruit#276.dst: Вроде уютно… но расслабиться трудно, учитывая… ну, понимаешь. Всё это.
Queen's Recruit#276.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#277.src: ...it's easier than I thought it would be, being in Fruma. There's enough distance from... the, uh, memories.
Queen's Recruit#277.dst: …в Fruma легче, чем я думал. Есть какая-то дистанция от… э, воспоминаний.
Queen's Recruit#277.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#278.src: But, okay, we're in private now. So.. what do you actually think of the tournament? It's weird, right? Why would we be invited for this?
Queen's Recruit#278.dst: Но ладно, мы теперь одни. Так… что ты на самом деле думаешь о турнире? Странно же, да? Зачем нас сюда позвали?
Queen's Recruit#278.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#279.src: Me neither. I don't know what I was expecting when we were entering Fruma, but it wasn't... this.
Queen's Recruit#279.dst: Я тоже. Не знаю, чего я ждал, въезжая в Fruma, но точно не… этого.
Queen's Recruit#279.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#280.src: I think we'll have to participate, but keep an eye out. Maybe the secret reward will have some answers..
Queen's Recruit#280.dst: Думаю, участвовать придётся, но смотреть в оба. Может, тайная награда что-то прояснит..
Queen's Recruit#280.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#281.src: Hm... you're probably right, I just don't know what it could possibly be.
Queen's Recruit#281.dst: Хм… наверное, так и есть, просто не представляю, что это может быть.
Queen's Recruit#281.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#282.src: Maybe there's something going on with that secret reward for the winner... we'll have to wait and see, I guess.
Queen's Recruit#282.dst: Может, дело в той тайной награде для победителя… поживём - увидим, наверное.
Queen's Recruit#282.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#283.src: Ha! Yeah, alright. I'm a little excited, too. I haven't had any friendly duels for a long time, so maybe it'll be nice to test my strength.
Queen's Recruit#283.dst: Ха! Да, ладно. Мне тоже немного не терпится. Давно не было дружеских дуэлей, так что проверить силы будет неплохо.
Queen's Recruit#283.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#284.src: But don’t forget why we’re here. Keep your guard up. Something about that reward she mentioned... it makes me uneasy.
Queen's Recruit#284.dst: Но не забывай, зачем мы здесь. Будь начеку. Что-то в той награде, о которой она говорила… меня тревожит.
Queen's Recruit#284.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#285.src: It strikes me as the kind of thing Aledar would enjoy. What better way to prove himself than to win this big tournament?
Queen's Recruit#285.dst: Это как раз во вкусе Aledar. Как лучше доказать себя, чем выиграть большой турнир?
Queen's Recruit#285.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#286.src: He'd get to use all his potions and tricks, too! He's always telling me about the horrific creations he's mixed together.
Queen's Recruit#286.dst: Он бы пустил в ход все свои зелья и уловки! Вечно рассказывает мне о жутких смесях, что намешал.
Queen's Recruit#286.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#289.src: It seems cozy enough, I guess... hard to relax, though, given... you know. all of it.
Queen's Recruit#289.dst: Вроде уютно… но расслабиться трудно, учитывая… ну, понимаешь. Всё это.
Queen's Recruit#289.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#290.src: ...it's easier than I thought it would be, being in Fruma. There's enough distance from... the, uh, memories.
Queen's Recruit#290.dst: …в Fruma легче, чем я думал. Есть какая-то дистанция от… э, воспоминаний.
Queen's Recruit#290.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#291.src: But, okay, we're in private now. So.. what do you actually think of the tournament? It's weird, right? Why would we be invited for this?
Queen's Recruit#291.dst: Но ладно, мы теперь одни. Так… что ты на самом деле думаешь о турнире? Странно же, да? Зачем нас сюда позвали?
Queen's Recruit#291.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#292.src: Me neither. I don't know what I was expecting when we were entering Fruma, but it wasn't... this.
Queen's Recruit#292.dst: Я тоже. Не знаю, чего я ждал, въезжая в Fruma, но точно не… этого.
Queen's Recruit#292.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#293.src: I think we'll have to participate, but keep an eye out. Maybe the secret reward will have some answers..
Queen's Recruit#293.dst: Думаю, участвовать придётся, но смотреть в оба. Может, тайная награда что-то прояснит..
Queen's Recruit#293.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#294.src: Hm... you're probably right, I just don't know what it could possibly be.
Queen's Recruit#294.dst: Хм… наверное, так и есть, просто не представляю, что это может быть.
Queen's Recruit#294.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#295.src: Maybe there's something going on with that secret reward for the winner... we'll have to wait and see, I guess.
Queen's Recruit#295.dst: Может, дело в той тайной награде для победителя… поживём - увидим, наверное.
Queen's Recruit#295.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#296.src: Ha! Yeah, alright. I'm a little excited, too. I haven't had any friendly duels for a long time, so maybe it'll be nice to test my strength.
Queen's Recruit#296.dst: Ха! Да, ладно. Мне тоже немного не терпится. Давно не было дружеских дуэлей, так что проверить силы будет неплохо.
Queen's Recruit#296.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#297.src: But don’t forget why we’re here. Keep your guard up. Something about that reward she mentioned... it makes me uneasy.
Queen's Recruit#297.dst: Но не забывай, зачем мы здесь. Будь начеку. Что-то в той награде, о которой она говорила… меня тревожит.
Queen's Recruit#297.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#298.src: It strikes me as the kind of thing Aledar would enjoy. What better way to prove himself than to win this big tournament?
Queen's Recruit#298.dst: Это как раз во вкусе Aledar. Как лучше доказать себя, чем выиграть большой турнир?
Queen's Recruit#298.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#299.src: He'd get to use all his potions and tricks, too! He's always telling me about the horrific creations he's mixed together.
Queen's Recruit#299.dst: Он бы пустил в ход все свои зелья и уловки! Вечно рассказывает мне о жутких смесях, что намешал.
Queen's Recruit#299.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#304.src: Oh, uh, nothing much. Just a secret meeting. In Jenprest's room that's W1, at the start of the corridor.
Queen's Recruit#304.dst: О, э, да ничего. Просто тайное собрание. В комнате Jenprest, это W1, в начале коридора.
Queen's Recruit#304.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#305.src: Picard says we should talk about what we've got so far. He also said to space out people coming to the room so wait a few minutes before stopping by!
Queen's Recruit#305.dst: Picard говорит, надо обсудить, что мы узнали. И сказал приходить по одному, так что подождите пару минут, прежде чем зайти!
Queen's Recruit#305.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#306.src: I... guess that makes sense. But why are you here, and not
Queen's Recruit#306.dst: Я… пожалуй, логично. Но почему пришёл ты, а не
Queen's Recruit#306.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#307.src: 'Cause I'm fast and stealthy. Gotta run now, I don't want to draw the guards' attention. Remember, room W1!
Queen's Recruit#307.dst: Потому что я быстрый и незаметный. Мне пора, не хочу привлекать стражу. Помните, комната W1!
Queen's Recruit#307.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#308.src: ...he's energetic, huh. Okay, let's head over to the meeting. I wonder what the others have noticed.
Queen's Recruit#308.dst: …энергичный он, а. Ладно, идём на собрание. Интересно, что заметили другие.
Queen's Recruit#308.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#309.src: Meet up with the others in room W-{~} at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#309.dst: Встреться с остальными в комнате W-{~} на [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#310.src: Ah, good, they're here. Come in, come in. Quickly now.
Queen's Recruit#310.dst: А, хорошо, они здесь. Входите, входите. Живее.
Queen's Recruit#310.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#311.src: Are we the last ones in?
Queen's Recruit#311.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#312.src: That y'are. Now, Picard, mind tellin' me what was on your damned mind when you commandeered my room without sayin' a word ?!
Queen's Recruit#312.dst: Они самые. Так, Picard, не объяснишь, какого лешего ты занял мою комнату, ни слова не сказав?!
Queen's Recruit#312.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#313.src: Ah, eheh, well I suppose it, er, may have slipped the mind... not important! We're under a time constraint!
Queen's Recruit#313.dst: Ах, хе-хе, ну, полагаю, это, э, вылетело из головы… неважно! У нас мало времени!
Queen's Recruit#313.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#314.src: We've made it this far, but we'll need to plan our next steps. Firstly, however let us start with what information we have gleaned thus far.
Queen's Recruit#314.dst: Мы зашли далеко, но надо спланировать дальнейшие шаги. Однако сперва - что мы успели выяснить.
Queen's Recruit#314.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#315.src: Well, the crown certainly has money to spare! What we've seen thus far seems to rival even the richest of nobility I had the pleasure of working with in {p}.
Queen's Recruit#315.dst: Что ж, денег у короны явно в избытке! Увиденное соперничает даже с богатейшей знатью, с которой я имел удовольствие работать в {p}.
Queen's Recruit#315.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#316.src: And the architectural style... it's unique. I haven't seen anything like it before. I suppose it would make sense, if the province has been closed off so long...
Queen's Recruit#316.dst: И архитектура… уникальна. Никогда такого не видела. Впрочем, логично, раз провинция так долго была закрыта…
Queen's Recruit#316.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#317.src: Eh, enough of the unimportant details any of the rest o' you feelin' strange about the tournament? Seems an odd thing to invite us folks back for.
Queen's Recruit#317.dst: Эх, хватит мелочей, кому-нибудь ещё турнир кажется странным? Чудной повод звать нас обратно.
Queen's Recruit#317.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#318.src: I was thinking the same thing. And they're willing to pay all of us for participating, no matter how we do... I don't get why.
Queen's Recruit#318.dst: Я думал о том же. И они готовы заплатить всем за участие, как бы мы ни выступили… не понимаю зачем.
Queen's Recruit#318.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#319.src: Hm, well, in truth I am not overly concerned about it
Queen's Recruit#319.dst: Хм, ну, по правде, меня это не слишком беспокоит
Queen's Recruit#319.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#320.src: Yes, actually, Picard, what was that back there in the dining hall? You're going to draw attention to yourself by opting out of it?
Queen's Recruit#320.dst: Да, кстати, Picard, что это было в обеденном зале? Отказываясь, вы же привлекаете к себе внимание?
Queen's Recruit#320.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#321.src: Oh, what use is there in placing me in such a combat scenario?! I'll be far more useful outside of that structure, free to look around the palace.
Queen's Recruit#321.dst: О, какой толк от меня в бою?! Вне этой структуры я куда полезнее, могу свободно осмотреть дворец.
Queen's Recruit#321.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#322.src: And besides, they have me giving them a summary of my research notes, so it's not as though I'm free of it entirely, not to mention
Queen's Recruit#322.dst: К тому же с меня требуют сводку моих исследовательских записей, так что я не совсем освобождён, не говоря уже о
Queen's Recruit#322.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#323.src: Alright, settle down y'all! Limited time, remember? We've gone off track. They're rich, fancy, and want us fightin' for some reason. What else?
Queen's Recruit#323.dst: Так, тихо все! Время ограничено, помните? Мы отвлеклись. Они богаты, пафосны и зачем-то хотят, чтоб мы дрались. Что ещё?
Queen's Recruit#323.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#324.src: ...as I was saying before I was rudely interrupted- I don't believe there is much to be gleaned from the tournament just yet. It's a puzzle piece we'll have to connect later.
Queen's Recruit#324.dst: …как я говорил, пока меня грубо не перебили, турнир пока мало что даёт. Это кусок головоломки, который мы сложим позже.
Queen's Recruit#324.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#325.src: Do we have anything on the Queen and her Sovereigns? It's an interesting governmental structure, but I suppose having a more direct line to the Queen has value for the districts.
Queen's Recruit#325.dst: А что у нас о Королеве и её Суверенах? Интересное устройство власти, но, полагаю, округам ценна более прямая связь с Королевой.
Queen's Recruit#325.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#326.src: Well, they're obviously putting on an act. They're definitely hiding something from us, and I don't think any of them are as happy to see us as they say they are.
Queen's Recruit#326.dst: Ну, они явно ломают комедию. Точно что-то скрывают, и не думаю, что кто-то из них так рад нас видеть, как говорит.
Queen's Recruit#326.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#327.src: Yes, indeed... we were sent to Wynn as exiles, not as honored soldiers. So why are they pretending otherwise? They called us back here.
Queen's Recruit#327.dst: Да, верно… нас отправили в Wynn изгнанниками, а не почётными солдатами. Зачем притворяться? Они сами позвали нас назад.
Queen's Recruit#327.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#328.src: Ah! Perhaps they're unaware that we've cracked that memory spell? For all they know, we still believe their lies.
Queen's Recruit#328.dst: А! Может, они не знают, что мы взломали то заклятие памяти? Насколько им известно, мы всё ещё верим их лжи.
Queen's Recruit#328.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#329.src: It'd explain some things, for certain...
Queen's Recruit#329.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#330.src: So am I the only one confused by the amount of guards around?
Queen's Recruit#330.dst: Только мне кажется странным, что тут так мало стражи?
Queen's Recruit#330.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#331.src: You'd think that nine strangers entering the royal palace would be placed under more watchful eyes.
Queen's Recruit#331.dst: Казалось бы, за девятью чужаками во дворце должны следить куда пристальнее.
Queen's Recruit#331.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#332.src: Now that you mention it... the only guards I saw on the way to our rooms were by the courtyard exit. There aren't any outside our rooms.
Queen's Recruit#332.dst: Раз уж ты сказал… по пути к комнатам я видел стражу только у выхода со двора. У наших дверей - никого.
Queen's Recruit#332.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#333.src: ...so we don't need to do the whole stealthy thing?
Queen's Recruit#333.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#335.src: Seems they want us t' feel safe and trusted. They've got to know we'll be talkin' about everything we see, so why not leave a good impression, eh?
Queen's Recruit#335.dst: Видать, хотят, чтоб мы чуяли себя в безопасности. Знают ведь, что всё растрезвоним, так чего б не впечатлить, а?
Queen's Recruit#335.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#336.src: Besides, they've got those two Sovereigns lookin' over us. Pretty strong, aren't they? Figure that's enough incentive not to cause trouble.
Queen's Recruit#336.dst: Да и те два Суверена за нами приглядывают. Сильны, а? Думаю, этого хватит, чтоб никто не буянил.
Queen's Recruit#336.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#337.src: Speakin' of the Sovereigns... and the guards by extension anyone else adept at readin' mana? It hardly feels like there's any of it in use at all!
Queen's Recruit#337.dst: Кстати о Суверенах… и страже тоже - кто умеет читать ману? Такое чувство, что ею тут почти не пользуются!
Queen's Recruit#337.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#338.src: I was going to bring that up. I haven't seen any mages at all. The closest I've seen is the higher ranked soldiers wielding magical weapons.
Queen's Recruit#338.dst: Я как раз хотела сказать. Я не видела ни одного мага. Разве что старшие чины с магическим оружием.
Queen's Recruit#338.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#339.src: I'm not as good with reading mana, but... there's something wrong with the Sovereigns. They've got an incredibly powerful aura surrounding them. It feels... unnatural.
Queen's Recruit#339.dst: Я плохо читаю ману, но… с Суверенами что-то не так. Вокруг них невероятно мощная аура. Она кажется… неестественной.
Queen's Recruit#339.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#340.src: Yes, you're right. They, and the Queen, are the only ones I've seen here who possess innate magical abilities. If anything, all three of them seem closely linked in terms of energy...
Queen's Recruit#340.dst: Да, верно. Кроме них и Королевы, я не видела здесь никого с врождённой магией. И по энергии все трое, похоже, тесно связаны…
Queen's Recruit#340.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#341.src: As interesting as that is, it doesn't leave much for the rest of us to go off of. Doctor, you're the one who organized us here. What are our plans?
Queen's Recruit#341.dst: Интересно, но нам остальным от этого мало толку. Доктор, это вы нас собрали. Каков план?
Queen's Recruit#341.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#342.src: Yes, that I am... well, it seems our most promising lead is the Sovereigns. We'll want to focus on them though, do not neglect general information. We still want to know as much about Fruma as possible.
Queen's Recruit#342.dst: Да, я… что ж, похоже, самая многообещающая зацепка - Суверены. Сосредоточимся на них, но и общих сведений не упускайте. О Fruma нужно узнать как можно больше.
Queen's Recruit#342.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#343.src: We've been running long enough, let's call it a day. Everyone, get some rest, we must be at our best performance tomorrow.
Queen's Recruit#343.dst: Мы засиделись, пора закругляться. Всем отдыхать, завтра нужно быть в лучшей форме.
Queen's Recruit#343.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#344.src: Let us gather here again tomorrow evening for another meeting. Goodnight, everyone.
Queen's Recruit#344.dst: Соберёмся здесь завтра вечером на новое совещание. Доброй ночи, все.
Queen's Recruit#344.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#345.src: Make your way back to W-{~} and sleep.
Queen's Recruit#345.dst: Вернись в комнату W-{~} и ляг спать.

Queen's Recruit#346.src: Those Sovereigns... they do concern me. If Fruma's leadership holds this much power, then...
Queen's Recruit#346.dst: Эти Суверены… они меня тревожат. Если у верхушки Fruma столько силы, то…
Queen's Recruit#346.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#347.src: Hm. Perhaps our King is right not to get on their bad side.
Queen's Recruit#347.dst: Хм. Может, король и прав, что не хочет с ними ссориться.
Queen's Recruit#347.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#348.src: Ah, great, now all o' you are lingerin'. Get out of my room! Not gonna get a lick o' sleep till you're gone...
Queen's Recruit#348.dst: Ну здорово, теперь вы все тут торчите. Вон из моей комнаты! Пока не уйдёте, глаз не сомкну…
Queen's Recruit#348.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#349.src: ...damned Doctor should'a just used his own room!!
Queen's Recruit#349.dst: …чёртов доктор мог бы и свою комнату занять!!
Queen's Recruit#349.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#350.src: ...sigh. What am I doing here? I should have stayed back in {p}.
Queen's Recruit#350.dst: …эх. Что я тут делаю? Надо было остаться в {p}.
Queen's Recruit#350.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#351.src: I just hope nobody here knew me before. I'm not sure I could handle that.
Queen's Recruit#351.dst: Лишь бы никто здесь не знал меня прежнего. Не уверен, что вынесу это.
Queen's Recruit#351.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#352.src: Hm... a shame I could not fight in the tournament. A monetary reward would be appreciated, given my dwindling research funds...
Queen's Recruit#352.dst: Хм… жаль, что мне нельзя сражаться в турнире. Награда бы пригодилась, мои средства на исследования тают…
Queen's Recruit#352.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#353.src: But, alas, I am no fighter. Perhaps the King would be willing to fund my future research...
Queen's Recruit#353.dst: Но, увы, я не боец. Может, король согласится оплатить мои будущие изыскания…
Queen's Recruit#353.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#354.src: Gosh, I hope my match tomorrow goes well. I'm a bit nervous... never really dueled anyone before!
Queen's Recruit#354.dst: Ох, лишь бы завтрашний бой прошёл хорошо. Я волнуюсь… никогда толком ни с кем не дралась!
Queen's Recruit#354.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#356.src: What? It's been a long day.
Queen's Recruit#356.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#357.src: That magic... why does it feel familiar? I can't pinpoint what it is, but...
Queen's Recruit#357.dst: Эта магия… почему она кажется знакомой? Не пойму, что это, но…
Queen's Recruit#357.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#358.src: Let's just go get some sleep.
Queen's Recruit#358.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#359.src: Goodnight, {u}. I hope you'll sleep better than I will.
Queen's Recruit#359.dst: Доброй ночи, {u}. Надеюсь, ты выспишься лучше меня.
Queen's Recruit#359.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#361.src: {u}! We're going to miss the first round if you sleep any longer!
Queen's Recruit#361.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#364.src: Well, I feel your pain. I don't think I got more than an hour or two. I kept... I should have expected it'd be worse here. I just hoped... well, it is what it is.
Queen's Recruit#364.dst: Понимаю. Я и часа-двух не поспал. Всё время… Надо было ожидать, что здесь будет хуже. Я лишь надеялся… что ж, как есть.
Queen's Recruit#364.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#365.src: But anyway, it's good you're up. A soldier just came by to tell us to head over to the tournament arena.
Queen's Recruit#365.dst: Но хорошо, что ты уже на ногах. Заходил солдат, сказал идти на турнирную арену.
Queen's Recruit#365.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#366.src: You... no, they just... knocked and slid the notice under the door.
Queen's Recruit#366.dst: Ты… нет, они просто… постучали и сунули записку под дверь.
Queen's Recruit#366.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#367.src: Was someone in our room during the night...?
Queen's Recruit#367.dst: Кто-то был ночью у нас в комнате…?
Queen's Recruit#367.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#368.src: I don't... like... that. Not at all.
Queen's Recruit#368.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#369.src: Still. We need to head over to the arena. Apparently, it's in the northern part of the palace.
Queen's Recruit#369.dst: И всё же. Надо идти на арену. Говорят, она в северной части дворца.
Queen's Recruit#369.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#370.src: Find the location of the tournament in the northern side of the palace at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#370.dst: Найди место турнира в северной части дворца на [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#371.src: Well, well. Looks like we'll finally get to test which o' us is stronger, eh, captain?
Queen's Recruit#371.dst: Так-так. Наконец проверим, кто из нас сильнее, а, капитан?
Queen's Recruit#371.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#372.src: Oh, finally? I wasn't aware there was even a question! Lieutenant, do you truly think you stand a chance against me?
Queen's Recruit#372.dst: О, наконец? Не знал, что тут есть вопрос! Лейтенант, ты правда думаешь, что у тебя есть шанс?
Queen's Recruit#372.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#373.src: Ah, enough o' your posturin', Kymer! You might be all up n' fancy these days, but I still remember when you were but a rookie, all afraid of a lil' old zombie!
Queen's Recruit#373.dst: Хватит выпендриваться, Kymer! Ты нынче весь из себя важный, но я помню, как ты салагой боялся старенького зомби!
Queen's Recruit#373.speaker: Jenprest
