Queen's Recruit#374.src: Ha! Ah, good times. Good times. You'll get your recognition too one of these days, you know. Maybe you'll even surpass my rank someday!
Queen's Recruit#374.dst: Ха! Ах, славные времена. Славные. Тебя тоже однажды оценят, знаешь. Может, даже обгонишь меня в звании!
Queen's Recruit#374.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#375.src: Eh, you say that every time. Besides, the lower ranks suit me well. Don't think I'd do well with all that "responsibility" the big wigs put on your shoulders.
Queen's Recruit#375.dst: Эх, ты всегда так говоришь. Да и низкие чины мне по душе. Не по мне вся эта «ответственность», что шишки на плечи валят.
Queen's Recruit#375.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#376.src: ...all that bein' said, you're still goin' down when it's our go! I got some new tricks since the last time we fought, so don't get too cocky!
Queen's Recruit#376.dst: …но всё равно, когда дойдёт до нас, ты ляжешь! Я с прошлого боя разучил пару трюков, так что не зазнавайся!
Queen's Recruit#376.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#377.src: Ha! Then I look forward to seeing them.
Queen's Recruit#377.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#378.src: If you're looking for the tournament arena, go down this corridor then turn to the left.
Queen's Recruit#378.dst: Если ищете турнирную арену, идите по этому коридору и сверните налево.
Queen's Recruit#378.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#379.src: The tournament arena is further down the corridor.
Queen's Recruit#379.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#380.src: This area is unfortunately not accessible at this moment.
Queen's Recruit#380.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#381.src: This is Her Majesty's own personal quarter.
Queen's Recruit#381.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#382.src: I'm afraid I can't let you in just yet. Not until
Queen's Recruit#382.dst: Боюсь, пока я не могу вас впустить. Пока не
Queen's Recruit#382.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#383.src: Yes, yes, my research notes, I am aware. It has been sorted already. May I visit the library now?
Queen's Recruit#383.dst: Да-да, мои записи, я в курсе. Я их уже сдал. Можно мне теперь в библиотеку?
Queen's Recruit#383.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#384.src: Don't interrupt me. You can't enter until this round of tournament matches concludes. Her Majesty's orders.
Queen's Recruit#384.dst: Не перебивайте. Входить нельзя, пока не кончится этот раунд турнира. Приказ Её Величества.
Queen's Recruit#384.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#385.src: Pah. Fine! Fine, yes, I'll wait. Good grief.
Queen's Recruit#385.dst: Пф. Ладно! Ладно, да, подожду. Боже правый.
Queen's Recruit#385.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#386.src: You'd think I would have some level of freedom, but no! What does it matter if I don't want to watch the matches if there's nothing else to do?!
Queen's Recruit#386.dst: Казалось бы, мне положена хоть какая-то свобода, но нет! Какая разница, что я не хочу смотреть бои, если делать больше нечего?!
Queen's Recruit#386.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#387.src: Oh, just go and get your match over with. Quit stalling.
Queen's Recruit#387.dst: Ох, иди уже, отвоюй свой бой. Хватит тянуть.
Queen's Recruit#387.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#389.src: Just head down these stairs to find the tournament arena.
Queen's Recruit#389.dst: Спуститесь по этой лестнице - там турнирная арена.
Queen's Recruit#389.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#390.src: The match ups will be announced once everyone is present.
Queen's Recruit#390.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#391.src: Uh. Sovereign... Majin? Sovereign Majin. We're all here.
Queen's Recruit#391.dst: Э. Суверен… Majin? Суверен Majin. Мы все здесь.
Queen's Recruit#391.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#392.src: My, it's about time! As guests of the crown, it would do you well to arrive on time for such things, hm? Tardiness is not a good look.
Queen's Recruit#392.dst: Ну наконец-то! Гостям короны не мешало бы приходить на такое вовремя, хм? Опоздания вам не к лицу.
Queen's Recruit#392.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#393.src: Our apologies, Sovereign. It would seem we were not given the time to be here in advance a humble mistake, I'm certain.
Queen's Recruit#393.dst: Приносим извинения, Суверен. Похоже, нам не дали времени прийти заранее - невинная ошибка, уверен.
Queen's Recruit#393.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#394.src: Ah, the incompetence of our lessers... it never ceases to amaze! Nevertheless, the duty of arriving on schedule remains on your shoulders. Do better next time, would you?
Queen's Recruit#394.dst: Ах, некомпетентность низших… не перестаёт поражать! И всё же приходить вовремя - ваша обязанность. В следующий раз постарайтесь, ладно?
Queen's Recruit#394.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#395.src: Now, I am a very busy man, so I will keep this brief. As Her Majesty has already explained, this tournament will consist of multiple duels! You are not required to watch each match.
Queen's Recruit#395.dst: Итак, я очень занятой человек, так что буду краток. Как уже объяснила Её Величество, турнир состоит из множества дуэлей! Смотреть каждый бой не обязательно.
Queen's Recruit#395.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#396.src: The standard rules apply. No killing, no maiming, no attacking anyone outside the arena - though, do try, I'd find much pleasure in watching you fail!
Queen's Recruit#396.dst: Правила обычные. Не убивать, не калечить, не нападать ни на кого вне арены - впрочем, попробуйте, я с удовольствием посмотрю на ваш провал!
Queen's Recruit#396.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#397.src: With that settled, are there any questions? I would certainly hope not, I have much to return to once this is
Queen's Recruit#397.dst: На этом всё, вопросы есть? Надеюсь, нет, у меня ещё уйма дел, как только это
Queen's Recruit#397.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#398.src: Ah, I do I am not participating in the tournament. I had been told to expect some alternative today.
Queen's Recruit#398.dst: А, у меня… я не участвую в турнире. Мне сказали, что сегодня для меня будет что-то другое.
Queen's Recruit#398.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#399.src: Oh, yes... you. What did you say you were again, a... researcher?
Queen's Recruit#399.dst: О, да… ты. Кем ты там себя назвал, э… исследователем?
Queen's Recruit#399.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#400.src: Ahahaha! Oh, and they selected you as one of your province's greatest? Don't make me laugh! Ahahahahaha!
Queen's Recruit#400.dst: Ахахаха! И тебя выбрали одним из лучших в провинции? Не смеши! Ахахахаха!
Queen's Recruit#400.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#401.src: Ah, but it's just as well, I suppose. Nine certainly doesn't fit cleanly for such a tournament. Better a researcher than a ninth fighter!
Queen's Recruit#401.dst: Ах, но оно и к лучшему. Девять - число для турнира неудобное. Уж лучше исследователь, чем девятый боец!
Queen's Recruit#401.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#402.src: Yes, someone will be with you shortly. Just sit on the sidelines and twiddle your thumbs, or whatever you do you certainly aren't my problem anymore.
Queen's Recruit#402.dst: Да, за тобой скоро придут. Сиди в сторонке и крути пальцами, или чем ты там занимаешься - ты уже не моя забота.
Queen's Recruit#402.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#405.src: Excellent! The first match up appears to be... {u} and Mel. Step forward, the two of you.
Queen's Recruit#405.dst: Превосходно! Первая пара, похоже… {u} и Mel. Выйдите вперёд, вы двое.
Queen's Recruit#405.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#408.src: Well, hurry up now, get prepared! Choose a corridor each, north or south, and get to fighting already!
Queen's Recruit#408.dst: Ну, живее, готовьтесь! Выберите по коридору, северный или южный, и сражайтесь уже!
Queen's Recruit#408.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#409.src: As for the rest of you... oh, I can't be bothered. Read your matchups on the board yourselves.
Queen's Recruit#409.dst: А остальные… ох, мне лень. Сами смотрите пары на доске.
Queen's Recruit#409.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#410.src: Uh... alrighty then. I guess I'll choose this one.
Queen's Recruit#410.dst: Э… ну ладно. Тогда я выберу этот.
Queen's Recruit#410.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#411.src: Begin your fight against Mel in the southern waiting room.
Queen's Recruit#411.dst: Начни бой с Mel в южной комнате ожидания.

Queen's Recruit#413.src: Just 'cause we've got a mission here, doesn't mean I'll go easy on ya!
Queen's Recruit#413.dst: Задание заданием, но поддаваться не буду!
Queen's Recruit#413.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#414.src: Ready to go?! Let's show them what we're made of!
Queen's Recruit#414.dst: Ну что, начнём?! Покажем им, на что способны!
Queen's Recruit#414.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#415.src: Phew! What a fight! Got my blood rushin'!
Queen's Recruit#415.dst: Фух! Вот это бой! Аж кровь закипела!
Queen's Recruit#415.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#416.src: What'd you think of my trick? Pretty good, right? Makes me less of a sittin' duck in combat!
Queen's Recruit#416.dst: Как тебе мой трюк? Неплохо, а? С ним я в бою не лёгкая мишень!
Queen's Recruit#416.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#417.src: Ah, I didn't think I was gonna be winnin' anything, really. But it was fun givin' it a shot.
Queen's Recruit#417.dst: Ах, я и не думала, что что-то выиграю. Но попробовать было весело.
Queen's Recruit#417.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#418.src: {u} has bested Mel in the first round, and will progress to the next!
Queen's Recruit#418.dst: {u} побеждает Mel в первом раунде и проходит дальше!
Queen's Recruit#418.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#420.src: You will be permitted to remain in the palace for the duration of the tournament. You will be paid for your participation at the end of your stay.
Queen's Recruit#420.dst: Вам разрешено оставаться во дворце до конца турнира. Оплату за участие получите в конце пребывания.
Queen's Recruit#420.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#421.src: I figure that makes sense. I wonder when Lanu's match is...
Queen's Recruit#421.dst: Логично. Интересно, когда бой у Lanu…
Queen's Recruit#421.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#422.src: {u}, congratulations on your victory. You will be notified when your next match is. In the meantime, feel free to rest.
Queen's Recruit#422.dst: {u}, поздравляем с победой. О следующем бое вам сообщат. А пока можете отдыхать.
Queen's Recruit#422.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#423.src: Leave the arena waiting room and find Picard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#423.dst: Покинь комнату ожидания и найди Picard на [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#424.src: It was a good fight! But you'd better win in my honor now, y'hear?
Queen's Recruit#424.dst: Хороший был бой! Но теперь побеждай в мою честь, слыхал?
Queen's Recruit#424.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#425.src: We will announce your next match later. Please feel free to rest or enjoy the palace in the meantime.
Queen's Recruit#425.dst: О следующем бое объявим позже. А пока отдыхайте или осмотрите дворец.
Queen's Recruit#425.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#426.src: Ah, {u}, I saw the match! Very good technique, better than many soldiers I've seen pass through {p} in my time.
Queen's Recruit#426.dst: А, {u}, я видел бой! Отличная техника, лучше, чем у многих солдат, что прошли через {p} на моём веку.
Queen's Recruit#426.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#427.src: I suppose I'm not surprised! When the tournament was announced, you came to mind as a potential winner. You, and one other person, that is.
Queen's Recruit#427.dst: Впрочем, не удивлён! Когда объявили турнир, я сразу подумал о тебе как о возможном победителе. О тебе и ещё об одном человеке.
Queen's Recruit#427.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#428.src: Hm... maybe I could start taking bets on who will win... ah, no, no, I'm far too busy. Stay focused, Picard.
Queen's Recruit#428.dst: Хм… может, принимать ставки на победителя… ах, нет-нет, я слишком занят. Сосредоточься, Picard.
Queen's Recruit#428.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#429.src: Hm? Oh dear, I'd forgotten you were here! Yes, I was going to do something...
Queen's Recruit#429.dst: Хм? Батюшки, я и забыл, что ты тут! Да, я собирался кое-что сделать…
Queen's Recruit#429.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#430.src: Oh! The library! Can you believe it, that damnable guard finally stepped away! It's ridiculous, really who even cares to guard a library of all things?!
Queen's Recruit#430.dst: О! Библиотека! Представляешь, этот треклятый стражник наконец отошёл! Нелепость - кому вообще надо стеречь библиотеку?!
Queen's Recruit#430.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#431.src: But. But but but. The way is open, and although the tournament round is still ongoing, I'd like to take the opportunity while I can!
Queen's Recruit#431.dst: Но. Но-но-но. Путь открыт, и хоть раунд ещё идёт, я хочу воспользоваться случаем, пока могу!
Queen's Recruit#431.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#432.src: Care to join me? I'm sure there's something you'll find interesting in there. What sorts of knowledge have the Frumans kept hidden in these walls...
Queen's Recruit#432.dst: Составишь компанию? Уверен, там найдётся что-то интересное. Какие знания жители Fruma спрятали в этих стенах…
Queen's Recruit#432.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#433.src: Well, are you coming? Come now, quickly, before the guard returns!
Queen's Recruit#433.dst: Ну, идёшь? Скорее, пока стражник не вернулся!
Queen's Recruit#433.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#435.src: Goodness, where to even begin? There's so much here...
Queen's Recruit#435.dst: Боже, с чего и начать? Тут столько всего…
Queen's Recruit#435.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#436.src: I hereby introduce to you The Evermoving Zephyr, the ruler of the {p}, the latest in the line of one of Fruma's great noble houses! His lordship, Sovereign Zhiraok Nasin!
Queen's Recruit#436.dst: Представляю вам Неустанного Зефира, правителя {p}, последнего потомка одного из великих знатных домов Fruma! Его светлость, Суверен Zhiraok Nasin!

Queen's Recruit#437.src: ...and that we're rifling through the Cursed instead of our own citizens is an incalculable risk!
Queen's Recruit#437.dst: …а то, что мы копаемся в Проклятых, а не в своих гражданах, - неисчислимый риск!

Queen's Recruit#438.src: What was that?! Quickly, quickly now, follow me!
Queen's Recruit#438.dst: Что это было?! Скорее, скорее, за мной!
Queen's Recruit#438.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#439.src: Do you have eyes on the speaker? Who is it?
Queen's Recruit#439.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#440.src: I can't find her angle for this hunt.
Queen's Recruit#440.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#441.src: Ah, it's like I'm talking with her again! It's so nostalgic to speak with a clueless Nasin trying their hardest, in spite of their incompe
Queen's Recruit#441.dst: Ах, будто снова говорю с ней! Как ностальгично видеть бестолкового Nasin, что из кожи вон лезет, несмотря на свою бездарн
Queen's Recruit#441.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#442.src: I'M SORRY, YOU IGNORANT INTEGRAND? You really think now is the time for- Rrgh... Why. Do I even bother.
Queen's Recruit#442.dst: ЧТО-ЧТО, НЕВЕЖДА-ИНТЕГРАЛ? Думаешь, сейчас время… Ррр… Зачем. Я вообще стараюсь.
Queen's Recruit#442.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#443.src: Why, indeed! It truly is a bad habit. Something to work on while your seniors do the important work, hm?
Queen's Recruit#443.dst: И впрямь, зачем! Дурная привычка. Поработай над ней, пока старшие заняты важным, хм?
Queen's Recruit#443.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#444.src: Speaking of, I must put forth that I do find this all a bit strange. We most certainly aren't lacking in strength here, so why bother with the exiles?
Queen's Recruit#444.dst: Кстати, должен заметить, всё это мне кажется странным. В силе у нас недостатка нет, так зачем возиться с изгнанниками?
Queen's Recruit#444.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#445.src: ...sigh... The risk factor is much greater than I'd bet on. She has to know more than we do, so maybe we'll get a summation later.
Queen's Recruit#445.dst: …эх… Коэффициент риска куда выше, чем я бы поставил. Она знает больше нас, так что, может, позже получим итоговую сумму.
Queen's Recruit#445.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#447.src: Ah, there she is. Fashionably late as always!
Queen's Recruit#447.dst: А, вот и она. Как всегда, изысканно опаздывает!
Queen's Recruit#447.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#448.src: Hm. If anything, I was early.

Queen's Recruit#449.src: I'd say your timing was golden- if you're here for that summation I mentioned, and this isn't anything else.
Queen's Recruit#449.dst: Сказал бы, что время ты выбрала золотое, как сечение, - если ты за той суммой, а не за чем-то ещё.
Queen's Recruit#449.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#450.src: It's the former. But first, have you been watching the battles? Do any of the contestants stick out to you?
Queen's Recruit#450.dst: За ней. Но сперва: вы следили за боями? Кто-нибудь из участников выделяется?

Queen's Recruit#451.src: Stick out? Hardly. Thus far, I have been thoroughly unimpressed.
Queen's Recruit#451.dst: Выделяется? Едва ли. Пока что никто меня не впечатлил.
Queen's Recruit#451.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#452.src: Naturally you would be. I've seen some generally promising things, but I need to know the expected solution to narrow the pool
Queen's Recruit#452.dst: Ещё бы. Я видел кое-что многообещающее, но мне нужно знать ожидаемое решение, чтобы сузить выборку
Queen's Recruit#452.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#453.src: Ah, ah! Settle down, Nasin, your betters are speaking. Calculate yourself out of dead last, first.
Queen's Recruit#453.dst: А-а! Уймись, Nasin, старшие говорят. Сперва вычисли, как выбраться с последнего места.
Queen's Recruit#453.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#454.src: Later, then. We have problems. The contestants have been sneaking around. And the doctor has been taking meticulous notes.
Queen's Recruit#454.dst: Тогда позже. У нас проблемы. Участники шныряют по дворцу. А доктор ведёт дотошные записи.

Queen's Recruit#455.src: ...looks like you letting him sit out the problem was a miscalculation, huh?
Queen's Recruit#455.dst: …похоже, отпустить его с задачи было просчётом, а?
Queen's Recruit#455.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#456.src: For once, we appear to be in agreement. What a pity, what a hassle... it hardly seems worth the effort to me.
Queen's Recruit#456.dst: Раз в кои-то веки мы согласны. Как жаль, как хлопотно… по мне, не стоит и усилий.
Queen's Recruit#456.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#457.src: It will be. But I've spent too much time here already. You'll have to wait for answers.
Queen's Recruit#457.dst: Стоит. Но я и так тут задержалась. Ответов придётся подождать.

Queen's Recruit#458.src: Of course. How much more irrational can we get, I wonder.
Queen's Recruit#458.dst: Разумеется. Интересно, насколько иррациональнее мы можем стать.
Queen's Recruit#458.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#459.src: If you'd like something to look out for, one of the more promising candidates is set to have a match soon. Go watch it.
Queen's Recruit#459.dst: Хотите за кем-то следить - у одного из лучших кандидатов скоро бой. Сходите посмотрите.

Queen's Recruit#460.src: A joy as always. Well, you heard her, Nasin! Chop chop, off to the stands we go!
Queen's Recruit#460.dst: Как всегда, одно удовольствие. Ну, слышал её, Nasin! Живо, на трибуны!
Queen's Recruit#460.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#461.src: ...so not even the Sovereigns know what's happening. Fascinating. Very fascinating.
Queen's Recruit#461.dst: …так даже Суверены не знают, что происходит. Любопытно. Очень любопытно.
Queen's Recruit#461.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#462.src: And there was a third! Who were they? Another Sovereign...? Damn it, damn it all, how did I not notice?
Queen's Recruit#462.dst: И был третий! Кто это? Ещё один Суверен…? Чёрт, чёрт побери, как я не заметил?
Queen's Recruit#462.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#463.src: Well, they appear to be onto us. No matter. We'll need to be more careful.
Queen's Recruit#463.dst: Что ж, они нас раскусили. Неважно. Будем осторожнее.
Queen's Recruit#463.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#464.src: You'd best get back to the arena. In the meantime, I'll keep searching here... there must be something useful!
Queen's Recruit#464.dst: Лучше возвращайся на арену. А я поищу здесь… должно же быть что-то полезное!
Queen's Recruit#464.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#466.src: ...hm? Oh, yes, fine, I'll tell the rest about what we heard. After I'm done here, of course.
Queen's Recruit#466.dst: …хм? А, да, ладно, расскажу остальным, что мы услышали. Когда закончу здесь, конечно.
Queen's Recruit#466.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#467.src: The first round of the tournament has concluded!
Queen's Recruit#467.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#468.src: The names that will proceed to the next round... {u}! Tasim! Reynauld! Kymer!
Queen's Recruit#468.dst: В следующий раунд проходят… {u}! Tasim! Reynauld! Kymer!
Queen's Recruit#468.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#469.src: {u}, your match will begin shortly. Your opponent is already in the waiting room.
Queen's Recruit#469.dst: {u}, ваш бой скоро начнётся. Соперник уже в комнате ожидания.
Queen's Recruit#469.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#470.src: Make your way to the arena.
Queen's Recruit#470.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#471.src: Begin your next duel in the arena down the stairs.
Queen's Recruit#471.dst: Начни следующую дуэль на арене внизу по лестнице.

Queen's Recruit#472.src: Please make your way to the arena by following the stairs down.
Queen's Recruit#472.dst: Пройдите на арену, спустившись по лестнице.
Queen's Recruit#472.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#473.src: Please go to the waiting room and prepare for the battle.
Queen's Recruit#473.dst: Пройдите в комнату ожидания и готовьтесь к бою.
Queen's Recruit#473.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#475.src: Well, you'll likely prove more of a challenge than Linton, that's for sure.
Queen's Recruit#475.dst: Что ж, с тобой точно будет потруднее, чем с Linton.
Queen's Recruit#475.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#476.src: You've come a long way since {p}, haven't you? Well, so have I! Let's battle.
Queen's Recruit#476.dst: Со времён {p} путь у тебя вышел долгий, да? Что ж, у меня тоже! Сразимся.
Queen's Recruit#476.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#477.src: The battle is decided! {u} has come out victorious.
Queen's Recruit#477.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#478.src: Ah... good fighting, {u}. I even used some of my most powerful arrows.
Queen's Recruit#478.dst: Ах… хороший бой, {u}. Я даже пустил в ход самые мощные стрелы.
Queen's Recruit#478.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#480.src: I know, I know. You were a worthy opponent, {u}. Now, you'll be winning this whole thing, yes?
Queen's Recruit#480.dst: Знаю, знаю. Ты достойный соперник, {u}. Теперь-то выиграешь всё, да?
Queen's Recruit#480.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#481.src: {u}, congratulations on reaching the finals. All other opponents have been defeated, except for you and your fellow finalist.
Queen's Recruit#481.dst: {u}, поздравляем с выходом в финал. Все соперники побеждены, кроме вас и второго финалиста.
Queen's Recruit#481.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#482.src: Hmph. That will be announced shortly. Please make your way to the courtyard and await further instructions.
Queen's Recruit#482.dst: Хмф. Об этом скоро объявят. Пройдите во внутренний двор и ждите указаний.
Queen's Recruit#482.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#483.src: Return to the courtyard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}] and find other contestants.
Queen's Recruit#483.dst: Вернись во внутренний двор на [-{~}, {~}, {~}] и найди других участников.

Queen's Recruit#484.src: I did well enough, I suppose. I'll be glad for this to all be over, anyway.
Queen's Recruit#484.dst: Пожалуй, выступил я достойно. Всё равно буду рад, когда это кончится.
Queen's Recruit#484.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#485.src: Please make your way to the courtyard and await further instructions.
Queen's Recruit#485.dst: Пройдите во внутренний двор и ждите указаний.
Queen's Recruit#485.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#486.src: {u}, you return! Well, how did your match go?
Queen's Recruit#486.dst: {u}, вот и ты! Ну, как прошёл бой?
Queen's Recruit#486.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#487.src: You? I suppose that would make sense. No offense intended, Reynauld, but I would have bet on {u} if I had the chance.
Queen's Recruit#487.dst: Ты? Что ж, логично. Без обид, Reynauld, но будь у меня шанс, я бы поставил на {u}.
Queen's Recruit#487.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#488.src: Ha. For me, certainly! It felt like I could barely make a dent in your stamina.
Queen's Recruit#488.dst: Ха. Для меня - ещё бы! Казалось, я тебя едва могу утомить.
Queen's Recruit#488.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#489.src: Yes, yes, congratulations are in order, and all that we have problems.
Queen's Recruit#489.dst: Да-да, поздравления и всё такое - у нас проблемы.
Queen's Recruit#489.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#490.src: It was problem enough that he was called here in the first place... to think, he could
Queen's Recruit#490.dst: Уже то, что его сюда позвали, было проблемой… подумать только, он мог бы
Queen's Recruit#490.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#491.src: That is enough about the tournament. I don't want to hear about it anymore. The doctor is right.
Queen's Recruit#491.dst: Хватит о турнире. Не хочу больше о нём слышать. Доктор прав.
Queen's Recruit#491.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#492.src: Yes, well, it's not your honour on the line... but fine, I admit, this third Sovereign is... troubling.
Queen's Recruit#492.dst: Да уж, не твоя честь на кону… но ладно, признаю, этот третий Суверен… тревожит.
Queen's Recruit#492.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#493.src: Hm. Have we been able to find the information we needed?
Queen's Recruit#493.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#494.src: No! And that is precisely our problem we are missing something, and we are running out of time! One final match, and then it's done.
Queen's Recruit#494.dst: Нет! В этом и беда - мы что-то упускаем, а время на исходе! Последний бой, и всё кончено.
Queen's Recruit#494.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#495.src: ...truthfully, I'm surprised you were on my side for that match.
Queen's Recruit#495.dst: …честно, не ждал, что в том бою ты будешь за меня.
Queen's Recruit#495.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#496.src: Ah, well, someone had t' take him down a peg! Guess that someone was you.
Queen's Recruit#496.dst: Ну, кто-то ж должен был сбить с него спесь! Выходит, это ты.
Queen's Recruit#496.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#497.src: Oh, give me a break, lieutenant. Him? Of all people to
Queen's Recruit#497.dst: Ой, да брось, лейтенант. Он? Из всех людей именно
Queen's Recruit#497.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#498.src: Hey, everyone's here! Is... this where they wanted everyone to gather up?
Queen's Recruit#498.dst: Эй, все здесь! Это… тут всем велели собраться?
Queen's Recruit#498.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#499.src: Seems that way. You won your match?
Queen's Recruit#499.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#500.src: I did. It seems I'm a finalist now. So, who's the other one?
Queen's Recruit#500.dst: Да. Похоже, я теперь финалист. А кто второй?
Queen's Recruit#500.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#501.src: Oh! Well, congratulations! Though, I guess we'll be facing each other soon.
Queen's Recruit#501.dst: О! Что ж, поздравляю! Правда, похоже, скоро нам сражаться друг с другом.
Queen's Recruit#501.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#502.src: Good grief... yes, the tournament has happened, congratulations to the finalists, whatever where are Mel and Linton? We need to discuss what's next, before
Queen's Recruit#502.dst: Боже правый… да, турнир прошёл, поздравляю финалистов, неважно - где Mel и Linton? Надо обсудить, что дальше, пока
Queen's Recruit#502.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#503.src: ...and so, what, I'm not allowed to take a nap now? I wasn't even fighting!! Mel, back me up, come on!
Queen's Recruit#503.dst: …и что, мне теперь и вздремнуть нельзя? Я даже не дрался!! Mel, поддержи меня, ну!
Queen's Recruit#503.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#504.src: He's right, this hardly seems fair! We were told we could stay in our rooms until the tournament had concluded, so why the change?!
Queen's Recruit#504.dst: Он прав, это нечестно! Нам сказали, что можно сидеть в комнатах до конца турнира, так с чего вдруг?!
Queen's Recruit#504.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#506.src: Any competitors who have lost in the tournament are to be escorted out of Fruma, effective immediately.
Queen's Recruit#506.dst: Все участники, проигравшие в турнире, немедленно выдворяются из Fruma под конвоем.
Queen's Recruit#506.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#507.src: what is the meaning of this?!
Queen's Recruit#507.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#508.src: SILENCE! These are new orders from Her Majesty.
Queen's Recruit#508.dst: МОЛЧАТЬ! Это новый приказ Её Величества.
Queen's Recruit#508.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#509.src: Only {u} and Tasim are permitted to remain in the palace. Any defiance will be seen as an official threat against Fruma from the Wynn province.
Queen's Recruit#509.dst: Во дворце разрешено остаться лишь {u} и Tasim. Любое неповиновение будет расценено как официальная угроза Fruma со стороны провинции Wynn.
Queen's Recruit#509.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#510.src: Comply, and no one will be hurt. You will still receive your promised reward for participation.
Queen's Recruit#510.dst: Подчинитесь, и никто не пострадает. Обещанную награду за участие вы всё равно получите.
Queen's Recruit#510.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#512.src: Enough, Kymer. What's done is done. We have no choice.
Queen's Recruit#512.dst: Довольно, Kymer. Что сделано, то сделано. Выбора нет.
Queen's Recruit#512.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#514.src: You two. Stay safe, and be on guard. I'll report back to the King with this news. If you're not released safely...
Queen's Recruit#514.dst: Вы двое. Берегите себя и будьте начеку. Я доложу королю. Если вас не отпустят целыми…
Queen's Recruit#514.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#515.src: ...{u}. Tasim. I've gotten what I came here for originally, but... I don't know what they're planning. You'll have to handle it on your own.
Queen's Recruit#515.dst: …{u}. Tasim. За чем я сюда приехал, я получил, но… не знаю, что они замышляют. Дальше вам придётся самим.
Queen's Recruit#515.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#517.src: Remaining finalists, you are expected in the dining hall shortly. Attend your last meal before the finals.
Queen's Recruit#517.dst: Оставшиеся финалисты, вас скоро ждут в обеденном зале. Это последняя трапеза перед финалом.
Queen's Recruit#517.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#519.src: What was that? What just happened?
Queen's Recruit#519.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#520.src: They've changed the rules on us, and now... ugh, we have no choice... We need to see it through.
Queen's Recruit#520.dst: Нам поменяли правила, и теперь… эх, выбора нет… придётся довести дело до конца.
Queen's Recruit#520.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#521.src: Well... come on. Let's attend our final dinner here.
Queen's Recruit#521.dst: Что ж… пойдём. На наш последний ужин здесь.
Queen's Recruit#521.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#523.src: What are we supposed to do...?
Queen's Recruit#523.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#524.src: They'll let us out. They have to. It'd be a diplomatic disaster if they didn't.
Queen's Recruit#524.dst: Нас отпустят. Должны. Иначе это будет дипломатическая катастрофа.
Queen's Recruit#524.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#526.src: If you were not already aware, your fellow soldiers have been returned to Wynn. Safely.
Queen's Recruit#526.dst: Если вы ещё не знаете, ваших товарищей вернули в Wynn. Невредимыми.
Queen's Recruit#526.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#527.src: ...if you don't mind me asking, Your Majesty, I thought we had an agreement? We would all remain here until the tournament concluded with the finals.
Queen's Recruit#527.dst: …позвольте спросить, Ваше Величество, разве мы не договаривались? Мы все остаёмся здесь до конца турнира, до финала.
Queen's Recruit#527.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#528.src: Oh? And would you like to join the rest of them? That could certainly be arranged we could simply select a victor here and now, and be done with this whole
Queen's Recruit#528.dst: О? А не желаешь присоединиться к ним? Это легко устроить - выберем победителя прямо сейчас и покончим со всем этим
Queen's Recruit#528.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#529.src: What is your problem, Thalas?! They're guests of Her Majesty! How irrational are you, trying to subtract them without her appr
Queen's Recruit#529.dst: Что с тобой не так, Thalas?! Они гости Её Величества! Как иррационально - вычитать их без её одобр
Queen's Recruit#529.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#531.src: To answer your question, the circumstances have changed. There is no need for the rest of your group to remain here.
Queen's Recruit#531.dst: Отвечу на ваш вопрос: обстоятельства изменились. Остальной вашей группе незачем здесь оставаться.
Queen's Recruit#531.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#532.src: The remainder of the tournament will proceed as expected.
Queen's Recruit#532.dst: Турнир завершится, как и было задумано.
Queen's Recruit#532.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#534.src: Good. Now, let us enjoy the meal!
Queen's Recruit#534.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#535.src: Another taste of Fruman cuisine... the meat was imported the {p}, and the vegetables came from the royal garden.
Queen's Recruit#535.dst: Ещё немного кухни Fruma… мясо привезено из {p}, а овощи - из королевского сада.
Queen's Recruit#535.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#536.src: Now, to business. The final will take place tomorrow morning. But first, I would like to speak to each of you individually.
Queen's Recruit#536.dst: Теперь о деле. Финал состоится завтра утром. Но сперва я хочу поговорить с каждым из вас наедине.
Queen's Recruit#536.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#537.src: Let us begin with... {u}. Please come to the north-eastern wing when you are ready.
Queen's Recruit#537.dst: Начнём с… {u}. Когда будете готовы, приходите в северо-восточное крыло.
Queen's Recruit#537.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#539.src: Talk to Her Majesty in the north-eastern wing of the palace at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#539.dst: Поговори с Её Величеством в северо-восточном крыле дворца на [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#542.src: Well. I suppose congratulations are in order, finalist.
Queen's Recruit#542.dst: Что ж. Полагаю, вас можно поздравить, финалист.
Queen's Recruit#542.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#543.src: You're curious, surely? For what purpose would I call you soldiers back to our province?
Queen's Recruit#543.dst: Вам ведь любопытно? Зачем мне было звать вас, солдат, обратно в нашу провинцию?
Queen's Recruit#543.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#544.src: Certainly not for a vanity tournament. A meaningless celebration.
Queen's Recruit#544.dst: Уж точно не ради тщеславного турнира. Бессмысленного празднества.
Queen's Recruit#544.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#545.src: Oh, let us drop the facade. I know what you have been doing in secret. I am not blind.
Queen's Recruit#545.dst: Ох, оставим притворство. Я знаю, чем вы занимались тайком. Я не слепа.
Queen's Recruit#545.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#546.src: You chose this opportunity to seek out information on our province. What little you have learned, we have deemed an acceptable cost.
Queen's Recruit#546.dst: Вы воспользовались случаем, чтобы разузнать о нашей провинции. То немногое, что вы узнали, мы сочли приемлемой ценой.
Queen's Recruit#546.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#547.src: Given the circumstances, I would have sacrificed much, much more if necessary.
Queen's Recruit#547.dst: В нынешних обстоятельствах я пожертвовала бы куда, куда большим.
Queen's Recruit#547.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#548.src: The greatest that Wynn has... a broad category. We had to thin the numbers a contest of strength did the job nicely.
Queen's Recruit#548.dst: Лучшие, что есть у Wynn… слишком широко. Нужно было сократить число - состязание в силе отлично справилось.
Queen's Recruit#548.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#549.src: And now... two candidates remain. You have done well to make it this far. I have been watching the duels intently, and you are certainly not unimpressive.
Queen's Recruit#549.dst: И вот… осталось двое. Вы хорошо справились, раз дошли досюда. Я пристально следила за дуэлями, и вы определённо впечатляете.
Queen's Recruit#549.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#550.src: Yet of the two of you... you certainly leave a lesser impression than him. You are one amongst hundreds, thousands... indistinguishable.
Queen's Recruit#550.dst: Но из вас двоих… вы производите меньшее впечатление, чем он. Таких, как вы, сотни, тысячи… не отличить.
Queen's Recruit#550.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#551.src: And still, here you stand. It intrigues me. What is so special about you? What strength has led you here?
Queen's Recruit#551.dst: И всё же вы здесь. Это меня занимает. Что в вас особенного? Какая сила привела вас сюда?
Queen's Recruit#551.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#552.src: But no matter. Answers will come with time... should you be selected. I can tell you have a question. Speak it.
Queen's Recruit#552.dst: Но неважно. Ответы придут со временем… если вас выберут. Вижу, у вас есть вопрос. Задайте его.
Queen's Recruit#552.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#553.src: Hm. A blank slate... to be able to see the outside world, for all its splendor and all its faults, to witness firsthand the deep rooted seeds of its inevitable destruction... there is value to that.
Queen's Recruit#553.dst: Хм. Чистый лист… увидеть внешний мир, со всем его величием и всеми изъянами, своими глазами узреть глубокие корни его неизбежной гибели… в этом есть ценность.
Queen's Recruit#553.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#554.src: You have seen it, haven't you? Forces beyond any of us vie for control of our world, caring not for what destruction they instill.
Queen's Recruit#554.dst: Вы ведь это видели? Силы, превосходящие любого из нас, борются за власть над миром, не заботясь о разрушениях, что сеют.
Queen's Recruit#554.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#555.src: And it truly is a beautiful world, isn't it? To think, it could be destroyed, taken for their ceaseless war which holds no meaning, no purpose...
Queen's Recruit#555.dst: А мир ведь прекрасен, не так ли? Подумать только, его могут уничтожить, отнять ради бесконечной войны без смысла и цели…
Queen's Recruit#555.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#556.src: Then you have seen firsthand the benefits. The province is unburdened by those who may cause problems, and Wynn's front in its war is bolstered.
Queen's Recruit#556.dst: Значит, вы видели пользу своими глазами. Провинция избавлена от тех, кто мог бы доставить хлопот, а фронт Wynn укреплён.
Queen's Recruit#556.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#557.src: Of course, many will refuse the call. Many more will grow stagnant in their newfound roles. Yet, in a select few... there is potential for much, much more.
Queen's Recruit#557.dst: Конечно, многие откажутся от призыва. Ещё больше застынет на новых местах. Но в немногих избранных… кроется куда больший потенциал.
Queen's Recruit#557.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#559.src: That will be all. Return to your chambers for the night. I will be sending for the other finalist shortly.
Queen's Recruit#559.dst: На этом всё. Возвращайтесь на ночь в свои покои. Я скоро пошлю за другим финалистом.
Queen's Recruit#559.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#560.src: Return to room W-{~} and talk to Tasim at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#560.dst: Вернись в комнату W-{~} и поговори с Tasim на [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#562.src: You're back! Still in one piece?
Queen's Recruit#562.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#563.src: ...I was getting a little worried. You were up there a while.
Queen's Recruit#563.dst: …я уже начал волноваться. Тебя долго не было.
Queen's Recruit#563.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#566.src: Ha. Well, now I'm a little nervous.
Queen's Recruit#566.dst: Ха. Ну, теперь я немного волнуюсь.
Queen's Recruit#566.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#568.src: I'll... need to ask some follow-up questions.
Queen's Recruit#568.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#570.src: Oh, this is a disaster. We've been separated, and now we're stuck in here.
Queen's Recruit#570.dst: Ох, это катастрофа. Нас разлучили, и мы тут застряли.
Queen's Recruit#570.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#571.src: We need to come up with a plan... is there a way we could
Queen's Recruit#571.dst: Надо придумать план… может, есть способ
Queen's Recruit#571.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#572.src: Tasim! Her Majesty will speak with you now.
Queen's Recruit#572.dst: Tasim! Её Величество примет вас сейчас.
Queen's Recruit#572.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#574.src: Okay, wish me luck. I'll be back.
Queen's Recruit#574.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#575.src: Don't... stay up waiting for me. You can go rest. I'll be... fine, probably.
Queen's Recruit#575.dst: Не… жди меня. Иди отдыхать. Со мной всё будет… нормально, наверное.
Queen's Recruit#575.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#580.src: It went... fine, I guess. She probably said... most of the same things to you.
Queen's Recruit#580.dst: Всё прошло… нормально, вроде. Сказала она… почти то же, что тебе.
Queen's Recruit#580.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#583.src: Could I ask you a favor?
Queen's Recruit#583.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#584.src: Could we spar? A test match, before... before tomorrow. Just like old times.
Queen's Recruit#584.dst: Давай сразимся? Пробный бой, до… до завтра. Как в старые времена.
Queen's Recruit#584.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#585.src: Just, get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#585.dst: Просто приготовься и приходи на арену. Хорошо?
Queen's Recruit#585.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#586.src: I yes. I'm okay. Just... could we spar? A test match, before... tomorrow. For old times' sake.
Queen's Recruit#586.dst: Я… да. Я в порядке. Просто… давай сразимся? Пробный бой, до… завтра. В память о былом.
Queen's Recruit#586.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#587.src: Just... get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#587.dst: Просто… приготовься и приходи на арену. Хорошо?
Queen's Recruit#587.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#590.src: It went... fine, I guess. She probably said... most of the same things to you.
Queen's Recruit#590.dst: Всё прошло… нормально, вроде. Сказала она… почти то же, что тебе.
Queen's Recruit#590.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#593.src: I was going to ask if I could ask you a favor.
Queen's Recruit#593.dst: Я хотел попросить тебя об одолжении.
Queen's Recruit#593.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#594.src: Could we spar? A test match, before... before tomorrow. Just like old times.
Queen's Recruit#594.dst: Давай сразимся? Пробный бой, до… до завтра. Как в старые времена.
Queen's Recruit#594.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#595.src: Just, get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#595.dst: Просто приготовься и приходи на арену. Хорошо?
Queen's Recruit#595.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#596.src: I yes. I'm okay. Just... could we spar? A test match, before... tomorrow. For old times' sake.
Queen's Recruit#596.dst: Я… да. Я в порядке. Просто… давай сразимся? Пробный бой, до… завтра. В память о былом.
Queen's Recruit#596.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#597.src: Just... get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#597.dst: Просто… приготовься и приходи на арену. Хорошо?
Queen's Recruit#597.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#603.src: He's... what what happened? How do you know? How how could you know?
Queen's Recruit#603.dst: Он… что… что случилось? Откуда ты знаешь? Как… как ты можешь знать?
Queen's Recruit#603.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#611.src: I... Gods. And, you you've been tr-trying to
Queen's Recruit#611.dst: Я… Боги. И ты… ты всё п-пытаешься
Queen's Recruit#611.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#613.src: I I need to go. I need some space. I'll I'm going to the arena. I need to... to...
Queen's Recruit#613.dst: Мне… мне надо уйти. Побыть одному. Я… я на арену. Мне нужно… нужно…
Queen's Recruit#613.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#614.src: No. No, d-don't. Don't do that. Not now, not not now. If... if you need me... you'll you'll know where I am.
Queen's Recruit#614.dst: Нет. Нет, н-не надо. Не надо так. Не сейчас, не… не сейчас. Если… если я нужен… ты… ты знаешь, где я.
Queen's Recruit#614.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#615.src: Head to the arena for a training match against Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#615.dst: Иди на арену на тренировочный бой с Tasim.

Queen's Recruit#616.src: Get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#616.dst: Приготовься и приходи на арену. Хорошо?
Queen's Recruit#616.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#617.src: It's... quiet. No guards in sight.
Queen's Recruit#617.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#619.src: Sigh. There's no point in trying to get out of here. We have to just see it through to the end.
Queen's Recruit#619.dst: Эх. Бежать отсюда бессмысленно. Придётся пройти всё до конца.
Queen's Recruit#619.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#621.src: What do you think? About what she said? About... forces destroying the world.
Queen's Recruit#621.dst: Что думаешь? О её словах? О… силах, что губят мир.
Queen's Recruit#621.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#622.src: She's right. I've seen it I know you've seen it. It's... getting worse.
Queen's Recruit#622.dst: Она права. Я видел это… знаю, ты тоже. И… становится хуже.
Queen's Recruit#622.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#623.src: But... the recruits. The recruits. I can't get over that. It's so...
Queen's Recruit#623.dst: Но… новобранцы. Новобранцы. Не могу с этим смириться. Это так…
Queen's Recruit#623.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#625.src: Let's just get down there and fight. Usual spots, right?
Queen's Recruit#625.dst: Давай просто спустимся и сразимся. Места как обычно, да?
Queen's Recruit#625.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#628.src: No words. Let's fight. Just just a training battle. To... test our skills.
Queen's Recruit#628.dst: Без слов. Сразимся. Просто… просто учебный бой. Чтобы… проверить силы.
Queen's Recruit#628.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#630.dst: Ха. Силы у тебя прибавилось, а?
Queen's Recruit#630.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#631.dst: И всё не могу тебя победить…
Queen's Recruit#631.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#632.src: I guess we know how tomorrow will turn out, then.
Queen's Recruit#632.dst: Что ж, значит, мы знаем, чем кончится завтра.
Queen's Recruit#632.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#633.src: No don't deny it. We both know I'm right.
Queen's Recruit#633.dst: Нет, не отрицай. Мы оба знаем, что я прав.
Queen's Recruit#633.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#635.src: She gave me a choice, you know?
Queen's Recruit#635.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#636.src: A choice. I don't know what to do with it. And... I'm afraid of taking either option.
Queen's Recruit#636.dst: Выбор. Не знаю, что с ним делать. И… боюсь выбрать любой из вариантов.
Queen's Recruit#636.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#637.src: I... I need to think over it some more. And we both need to rest.
Queen's Recruit#637.dst: Я… мне надо ещё подумать. И нам обоим нужен отдых.
Queen's Recruit#637.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#638.src: Huh? I... yes. I think I am. I just have a lot on my mind.
Queen's Recruit#638.dst: А? Я… да. Думаю, да. Просто много мыслей в голове.
Queen's Recruit#638.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#639.src: I'll... tell you in the morning. I just have a lot on my mind.
Queen's Recruit#639.dst: Я… расскажу утром. Просто много мыслей в голове.
Queen's Recruit#639.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#640.src: Ha. You're you're good. Oof. I'll be feeling that one for... for a while.
Queen's Recruit#640.dst: Ха. Ты… ты мастер. Ох. Это я ещё… долго буду чувствовать.
Queen's Recruit#640.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#642.src: Why did it have to come to this? Why couldn't why couldn't we all have just been happy?
Queen's Recruit#642.dst: Почему всё должно было так кончиться? Почему… почему мы не могли просто быть счастливы?
Queen's Recruit#642.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#643.src: He he sent me a letter for that mission, you know. Did I tell you that? It's why I went back to Wynn.
Queen's Recruit#643.dst: Он… он прислал мне письмо о том задании, знаешь. Я говорил? Потому я и вернулся в Wynn.
Queen's Recruit#643.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#644.src: And, it turns out he was already... already gone. And you were there, and I wasn't.
Queen's Recruit#644.dst: А оказалось, его уже… уже нет. И тебе довелось быть там, а мне нет.
Queen's Recruit#644.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#646.src: I want to blame you for it. I want to be able to be mad, to hate you. But... I can't. I just can't.
Queen's Recruit#646.dst: Я хочу винить тебя. Хочу злиться, ненавидеть тебя. Но… не могу. Просто не могу.
Queen's Recruit#646.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#647.src: I wish I could've been there. I wish I could've done it better. Maybe I could have or maybe it would've just gone the same way.
Queen's Recruit#647.dst: Жаль, что меня там не было. Жаль, что я не смог лучше. Может, я бы справился… а может, всё вышло бы так же.
Queen's Recruit#647.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#649.src: And now we're both here in the place we were all exiled from! But he's he isn't. He's gone, and and we're still here.
Queen's Recruit#649.dst: А теперь мы оба здесь, откуда нас всех изгнали! А он… его нет. Он ушёл, а… а мы всё ещё здесь.
Queen's Recruit#649.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#650.src: ...what am I supposed to do? What are we supposed to do? About all of this?
Queen's Recruit#650.dst: …что мне делать? Что нам делать? Со всем этим?
Queen's Recruit#650.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#653.src: I asked a lot of questions. I didn't like all the answers, but... she left me with a choice.
Queen's Recruit#653.dst: Я задал много вопросов. Не все ответы мне понравились, но… она оставила мне выбор.
Queen's Recruit#653.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#655.src: I don't know what to do. I need to... to... I need to think.
Queen's Recruit#655.dst: Не знаю, что делать. Мне нужно… нужно… нужно подумать.
Queen's Recruit#655.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#656.src: Give me some space, please. I'll see you in the morning.
Queen's Recruit#656.dst: Дай мне побыть одному, прошу. Увидимся утром.
Queen's Recruit#656.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#657.src: Return to your room and sleep for the night.
Queen's Recruit#657.dst: Вернись в комнату и ляг спать.

Queen's Recruit#659.src: Read the note Tasim left you before heading out.
Queen's Recruit#659.dst: Прочитай записку, которую Tasim оставил перед уходом.

Queen's Recruit#660.src: Head to Her Majesty's office for her decision.
Queen's Recruit#660.dst: Отправляйся в кабинет Её Величества за её решением.

Queen's Recruit#662.src: You've already failed, you know. You did not meet her criteria for selection.
Queen's Recruit#662.dst: Всё уже решено, знаешь ли. Её критериям отбора ты не отвечаешь.

Queen's Recruit#663.src: But is dismissing you outright an error? Certainly, you're powerful. Perhaps even more so than you should be, given the circumstances.
Queen's Recruit#663.dst: Но не ошибка ли - сразу тебя отбросить? Силы в тебе, бесспорно, много. Может, даже больше, чем положено в твоём положении.

Queen's Recruit#664.src: Still. You lack the drive, the perspective. The dedication. The understanding.
Queen's Recruit#664.dst: И всё же. Тебе недостаёт стремления, взгляда. Преданности. Понимания.

Queen's Recruit#665.src: And, most critically - you're unpredictable. And that makes you dangerous.

Queen's Recruit#666.src: Ah! It seems Her Majesty and I have come to the same conclusion. Wonderful.

Queen's Recruit#667.src: So, where does that leave you? Cast out, discarded?

Queen's Recruit#668.src: All the unanswered questions. Will you choose to let go? Dismiss the possibilities?

Queen's Recruit#669.src: And if not? What would you do for a glimpse of the truth? For a chance of receiving answers?

Queen's Recruit#670.src: Hm. Whatever the case, the choice is yours. Perhaps you'll surprise me, after all! Wouldn't that be exciting?

Queen's Recruit#671.src: {u}, under order of Her Majesty, you are to be escorted out of Fruma, effective immediately.
Queen's Recruit#671.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#672.src: Any defiance will be seen as an official threat against Fruma from the Wynn province. Comply, and no one will be hurt.
Queen's Recruit#672.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#673.src: You hold no power here. This choice is not yours. You will follow orders, or face the consequences.
Queen's Recruit#673.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#000~1.src: Mel and Lanu, you'll be in E{~}.
Queen's Recruit#000~1.dst: Mel и Lanu, вы в E{~}.

Queen's Recruit#001~1.src: Room W{~}... Now get going. I have a lot of rooms to assign...
Queen's Recruit#001~1.dst: Комната W{~}… А теперь идите. Мне ещё много комнат распределять…

Queen's Recruit#012~1.src: Pardon me, excuse me- coming through! Coming through! Ah, you two! Just the folks I was looking for.
Queen's Recruit#012~1.dst: Простите, извините - дайте пройти! Дайте пройти! А, вы двое! Как раз вас-то мне и надо.
Queen's Recruit#012~1.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#098~1.src: ...I'll get right to the point. We find ourselves in a very delicate position when it comes to our relations with our neighboring province, Fruma.
Queen's Recruit#098~1.dst: …Перейду сразу к делу. Наши отношения с соседней провинцией Fruma сейчас весьма щекотливы.
Queen's Recruit#098~1.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#101~1.src: Good. I guess that makes two of us.

Queen's Recruit#102~1.src: It sounds very suspicious. Why the sudden interest? Why now?
Queen's Recruit#102~1.dst: Звучит очень подозрительно. Откуда вдруг интерес? Почему сейчас?

Queen's Recruit#108~1.src: Ugh, we're not just going along with this, are we?
Queen's Recruit#108~1.dst: Ух, мы ведь не станем просто подыгрывать?
Queen's Recruit#108~1.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#115~1.src: ...even those of us with bad experiences with the province?
Queen's Recruit#115~1.dst: …даже те, у кого с провинцией плохой опыт?
Queen's Recruit#115~1.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#118~1.src: That is the plan, indeed! I'll explain more once we're there, but I believe we're on a time limit, correct?
Queen's Recruit#118~1.dst: Именно таков план! Подробнее объясню на месте, но у нас ведь мало времени, верно?
Queen's Recruit#118~1.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#186~1.src: Linton and Kymer are in W{~}.

similar.text: Linton and Kymer are in W2.

Queen's Recruit#232~1.src: There are others. Though, none could attend this event - they find themselves occupied with various assignments.
Queen's Recruit#232~1.dst: Есть и другие. Но никто не смог прийти - у всех свои поручения.
Queen's Recruit#232~1.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#233~1.src: Ah, there we are. Tasim and {u}, you'll be in room W{~}... in the western wing.
Queen's Recruit#233~1.dst: А, вот. Tasim и {u}, вы в комнате W{~}… в западном крыле.

Queen's Recruit#234~1.src: 'Cause I'm fast and stealthy. Gotta run now, I don't want to draw the guards' attention. Remember, room W{~}!
Queen's Recruit#234~1.dst: Потому что скорость и скрытность - моё всё. Мне пора, не хочу привлечь стражу. Помните, комната W{~}!

Queen's Recruit#291~1.src: But, okay, we're in private now. So... what do you actually think of the tournament? It's weird, right? Why would we be invited just for this?
Queen's Recruit#291~1.dst: Но ладно, теперь мы одни. Так… что ты на самом деле думаешь о турнире? Странно же? Зачем звать нас ради этого?
Queen's Recruit#291~1.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#309~1.src: Ha! Yeah, alright. I’m a little excited, too. I haven’t had any friendly duels for a long time, so maybe it’ll be nice to test my strength.
Queen's Recruit#309~1.dst: Ха! Да, ладно. Я тоже немного волнуюсь. Давно не было дружеских поединков, может, и приятно будет проверить силы.
Queen's Recruit#309~1.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#319~1.src: Picard says we should talk about what we've got so far. He also said to space out people coming to the room- so wait a few minutes before stopping by!
Queen's Recruit#319~1.dst: Picard говорит, надо обсудить, что мы уже узнали. И велел не идти в комнату толпой - так что подождите пару минут!
Queen's Recruit#319~1.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#349~1.src: Seems likely to me they want us t' feel safe and trusted. They've got to know we'll be talkin' about everything we see, so why not leave a good impression, eh?
Queen's Recruit#349~1.dst: По-моему, они хотят, чтоб мы чувствовали себя в безопасности. Знают ведь, что мы всё расскажем, так чего б не произвести хорошее впечатление?
Queen's Recruit#349~1.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#350~1.src: A strong spell should get through this wood without a problem.
Queen's Recruit#350~1.dst: Сильное заклинание должно без труда пробить эти доски.

Queen's Recruit#357~1.src: Yes, that I am... well, it seems our most promising lead is the Sovereigns. We'll want to focus on them- though, do not neglect general information. We still want to know as much about Fruma as possible.
Queen's Recruit#357~1.dst: Да, это я… что ж, самая многообещающая зацепка - Суверены. На них и сосредоточимся, но не пренебрегайте общими сведениями. Нам нужно узнать о Fruma как можно больше.
Queen's Recruit#357~1.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#417~1.src: Yes, someone will be with you shortly. Just sit on the sidelines and twiddle your thumbs, or whatever you do- you certainly aren't my problem anymore.
Queen's Recruit#417~1.dst: Да, скоро к тебе подойдут. Сиди в сторонке и крути пальцами или что ты там делаешь - ты теперь точно не моя забота.
Queen's Recruit#417~1.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#554~1.src: Another taste of Fruman cuisine... the meat was imported from the {p}, and the vegetables came from our royal garden.
Queen's Recruit#554~1.dst: Ещё одно блюдо кухни Fruma… мясо из {p}, а овощи из королевского сада.
Queen's Recruit#554~1.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#567~1.src: The greatest that Wynn has... a broad category. We had to thin the numbers - a contest of strength did the job nicely.
Queen's Recruit#567~1.dst: Лучшие, что есть в Wynn… широкое понятие. Пришлось сократить число - состязание силы отлично справилось.
Queen's Recruit#567~1.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#654~1.src: No- don't deny it. We both know I'm right.
Queen's Recruit#654~1.dst: Нет - не отрицай. Мы оба знаем, что это так.
Queen's Recruit#654~1.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#658~1.src: I... I need to think it over some more. And we both need to rest.
Queen's Recruit#658~1.dst: Мне… мне нужно ещё подумать. И нам обоим нужно отдохнуть.
Queen's Recruit#658~1.speaker: Tasim
